jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.We're looking for a Marketing Program Manager to join our Partner Marketing team and help us execute co\-marketing programs, events, and industry marketing with top game developers and technology partners. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, marketing, and program management, and plays an important part in supporting partner relationships and program delivery across our platform. Reporting to the Director, Partner Marketing, you'll work cross\-functionally to help ensure the successful launch of win\-win\-win campaigns: good for players, good for partners, and good for our business. You'll help keep timelines, processes, and cross\-functional coordination on track across sales, product, brand, creative, and channel teams. What You'll Be Doing Co\-Marketing Execution Support and execute partner co\-marketing campaigns across channels including owned social, email, in\-product placements, and live events. Help maintain marketing "playbooks" and repeatable program templates that support consistency and faster time\-to\-launch across partners. Support GTM planning for partner moments (new product launches, integrations, tentpole game releases), helping prepare materials and recommendations for review. Coordinate with partners' marketing counterparts on creative direction, promotional timing, approvals, and campaign deliverables. Cross\-Functional Program Coordination Provide day\-to\-day program support for Commerce partners, helping keep always\-on promotions running smoothly. Coordinate with Developer Solutions, Advertising, Commerce, PMM, and Channel Marketing teams to track timelines, deliverables, and responsibilities for partner\-facing programs. Maintain project timelines, flag dependencies and risks, and help facilitate regular syncs with internal stakeholders. Maintain intake and request\-tracking workflows (e.g., via Salesforce and Asana) so partner marketing requests are logged, prioritized, and actioned consistently. Support the development of B2B marketing collateral and presentations in partnership with Product Marketing and Consumer Marketing teams (newsletters, blog posts, case study amplification). Help coordinate partner workshops, innovation days, QBR presentations, and industry summits, using established frameworks and templates. Reporting \& Optimization Track campaign performance against business KPIs — including revenue supported, daily account linked players (DALP), and Commerce GMV — and help synthesize insights for the team. Help maintain a partner marketing roadmap that shows program activity and status for cross\-functional visibility. Flag recurring friction points (e.g., one\-off approval requests, low\-priority asks) to help the team improve processes over time. What you should have Experience 5–6 years of experience in partner marketing, co\-marketing, marketing operations, or program/project coordination — ideally in a tech, gaming, or platform company. Experience supporting cross\-functional marketing programs, from intake through launch and reporting. Some experience working directly with external partners or clients in a marketing capacity. Skills Solid project management instincts: comfortable tracking timelines, managing dependencies across multiple stakeholders, and flagging risks. Strong written and verbal communicator, able to organize information clearly for review by others. Detail\-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage an asset tracker or partner approval request end\-to\-end. Comfortable working in fast\-paced environments with shifting priorities. Good analytical instincts — comfortable pulling data and connecting program activity to business metrics with guidance. Tools Proficiency in project management and workflow tools (e.g., Asana, Salesforce, Notion, Google Workspace, Claude / AI). Familiarity with cross\-functional marketing operations, including intake and approval workflows. Experience with presentation\-heavy environments (Google Slides / PowerPoint) — you'll frequently build and review partner\-facing materials. Bonus Points Experience in the gaming industry or with game developer partnerships. Background in or exposure to developer marketing, platform marketing, or B2B marketing. Familiarity with co\-marketing in a deal context — where marketing is part of a larger commercial negotiation. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $148,000 to $166,500 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.Why Discord?Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of persona

jobs.title: CAP-CT Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary**

Involves analytical studies on a variety of policies, projects, programs and issues in support of a function, research initiative, program and / or organizational unit, or in research of new or changing systems and programs. Assists in policy and program planning, development, administration, management and implementation; interprets, monitors and analyzes information regarding policies and procedures and provides consultative services to department administrators and other stakeholders.


**Generic Scope**

Professional who applies acquired job skills, policies, and procedures to complete substantive assignments / projects / tasks of moderate scope and complexity; exercises judgment within defined guidelines and practices to determine appropriate action.


**Custom Scope**

The UCSF Division of Geriatrics seeks to recruit a full\-time **Program Coordinator** to support the implementation and operational ownership of a Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) funded program, Caregivers as Partners in Care Teams (CAP\-CT). This position reports to the Program Director and supports/leads a wide\-range of project operations and coordination tasks. The Program Coordinator will perform a broad range of duties that will require analytical, organizational, communication, technical, and coordination skills. Specific duties include: coordinating and maintaining project timelines and deliverables, assisting with researching and applying relevant policies, data collection, management, analyses and reporting, preparing and updating program materials/protocols/procedures, coordinating meeting schedules/agendas/minutes, drafting and updating documents, making program\-related purchases and submitting expense reports, conducting literature searches/reviews, and supporting manuscript preparation/scholarly dissemination. The Program Coordinator will additionally function as a subject matter expert and provide oversight and direction on learning management systems, manage digital education platforms, CE/CME accreditation coordination, analytics reporting, marketing communications, website management, and operational support across multiple projects and conferences. This position requires the ability to be proactive, resourceful and efficient, with a high level of flexibility. An ideal candidate will be able to work independently with minimal supervision, balances multiple competing priorities at any given time, and is intellectually curious, willing to learn new skills and a problem\-solver. The Program Coordinator may be required to provide the same level of support across projects/programs where there is a need.


**Department Overview**

The Division of Geriatrics’ work is grounded in a deep commitment to and respect for older persons from diverse backgrounds and lived experiences. We are specialists in aging. Our expertise is in optimizing the health of older individuals. We work in the community and on virtually every UCSF campus – Parnassus, San Francisco VA Health Care System, Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital, Mission Bay, and UCSF Center for Geriatric Care. The Division has over 130 employees including faculty, volunteer clinical faculty, fellows, staff, student interns and volunteers. We are deeply committed to, and will champion, diversity, equity and inclusion as our core mission. We will nurture and grow a culture in which everyone from all backgrounds is welcomed, supported, respected, and valued!


  
**Required Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of relevant experience.
* Working knowledge of common organization\- or research\-specific and other computer application programs.
* Proficient in communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Proficient in ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
* Demonstrates ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
* Demonstrates ability to analyze, research and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
* Proficient in ability to multi\-task with demanding timeframes.
* Experience in using Qualtrics/REDCap/other surveying platforms.
* Proficient in MS Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, etc.)
* Proficient with Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Learning Management System (LMS).
* Experience working with consumers of educational courses/academic institutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in public health or research administration, e.g. working on state contracts, NIH programs, or working in an academic institution.
* Previous experience using project management tools and software, website management and managing social media platforms.

**Required Education**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.

jobs.title: Food Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Food Program Coordinator

**Organization:** Daly City Partnership (DCP)

**Reports To:** Director of COVE

**Supervises:** \~20 Volunteers; provides secondary supervision and support when the primary supervisor is unavailable

**Salary Range:** Grade 7 ($28/hr \- $31/hr)

**FLSA Status:** Full\-Time \| 40 hrs/week

**About Daly City Peninsula Partnership Collaborative**

Daly City Partnership is a 501(c)(3\) non\-profit organization dedicated to creating transformative change in Northern San Mateo County. We provide comprehensive, multi\-generational services that empower children, families, and older adults to overcome challenges and promote community advancement. Our vision is a thriving community where everyone is empowered to reach their full potential, driven by our core values of Community, Responsibility, Determination, and Compassion. 

**Position Overview**

The Food Distribution Coordinator oversees the daily operations of DCP’s food programs. This includes organizing weekly food distributions, managing volunteers, maintaining inventory, and submitting reports. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, dependable, and enjoys engaging with both the community and volunteers in a fast\-paced environment. Supervised by the Director of COVE. 

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 1–2 years' experience in a leadership role, program coordination or volunteer management
* Valid California driver’s license and a driving record that meets the organization’s insurance requirements
* Must maintain a clean and insurable driving record throughout employment.
* Experience working with diverse populations
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Familiar with Microsoft Office

**Preferred Qualifications (In Addition To Those Above)**

* Bilingual in Spanish, Tagalog, Cantonese, or Mandarin
* Experience in food security or nonprofit programs

**Operational Responsibilities**

* Act as the lead coordinator for the grocery rescue program and Project Dash, managing logistics, scheduling, and partner communication.
* Safely drive the organization's van to execute grocery rescue pickups and perform Project Dash home deliveries (up to twice a week).
* Coordinate daily operations for Project Dash and satellite site distributions.
* Serve as operational support to the main food distribution program as needed.
* Train and supervise volunteers, ensuring compliance with safety and civil rights protocols
* Maintain volunteer records, monitor performance, and foster an inclusive team environment
* Support clients during distribution and connect them to additional resources as needed
* Utilize digital platforms for communication, scheduling, and tracking volunteer engagement

**Ability to:**

* Follow food safety and civil rights regulations
* De\-escalate and resolve client concerns
* Keep confidentiality of client and volunteer information
* Be able to lift up to 50 pounds, occasionally.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Must perform a background check and driving record check

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Paid Holidays, Sick leave
* 403 (b) plan
* Ongoing training, growth \& advancement opportunities

Employment with Daly City Partnership is "at\-will." Either the employee or the organization may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment. 

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter and complete all questions and assessments on Indeed.

***Join a caring and dedicated team of co\-workers and volunteers who take great pride and joy in helping members of our community succeed and thrive!***

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $28\.00 \- $31\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 403(b)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Language:

* Spanish, Tagalog, Cantonese, or Mandarin  (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Rental Events Operations Coordinator, Temp (7 months)
jobs.description:
The San Francisco Museum of Modern Art is one of the largest museums of modern and contemporary art in the United States and a thriving cultural center for the Bay Area. We cannot imagine life without art; it inspires and connects us every day. Now more than ever, these connections matter and are aligned with our **values**.

**Inclusive**: We strive to be a museum of many voices in dialogue.

**Passionate**: We believe working with art is more than a job or trusteeship \- it's a way of life.

**Brave**: We are committed to approaching our work with courage and a sense of adventure, always ready to explore new perspectives.

**Empathic**: We aim to act like a person, not an institution.

SFMOMA is a place for the infinitely curious to explore, support, and experience the art of our time. We believe that modern and contemporary art can influence the way we think, view the world, and embrace the many voices and perspectives around us. We aspire to foster an environment that elicits joy, nurtures a sense of belonging and purpose—where difference is seen as a strength, and every one is appreciated for their whole self. **Schedule**: Full Time, 35 hours/week, Temporary (7 months), at least three days working onsite

The Rental Events Operations Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the daily operations of the Rental Events team, contributing to the successful planning and seamless execution of all Rental Events. This position requires clear, direct, and professional communication with internal partners, clients, and vendors.

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for generating event documentation, assisting in the instruction and guidance of the on\-call Event Specialist team, and supporting the Operations Manager in relaying to museum colleagues in other departments the scheduling details and overall impact of upcoming rental events. This role demands strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across teams to uphold customer service standards and operational efficiency.

Working flexible hours onsite, including evenings and weekends, this position supports and reports to the Rental Events Operations Manager.
### **Responsibilities \& Duties**

* Act as onsite point\-of\-contact for vendors, clients, and museum staff while executing active events, ensuring all policies and procedures of the museum are followed.
* Assist in guiding and counseling the on\-call Event Specialists assigned to an event. Ensure the on\-call staff adheres to the event timeline (including following scheduled meal breaks) and promptly completes event duties during events.
* Support Rental Events Operations Manager with drafting event documentation, updating all event management and scheduling software, and updating project task lists.
* Display exceptional customer service skills, including clear and thoughtful communication with internal and external partners, as well as a willingness to go above and beyond to deliver exemplary experiences to clients.
* Assist the Operations Manager in scheduling the on\-call Event Specialists needed to support all Rental Events.
* Problem\-solve with a wide range of stakeholders, becoming an expert in the execution of museum policy and procedure during events.
* Partner closely with the Facility Operations, Janitorial, Engineering, and Security teams to ensure they are appropriately staffed to support Rental Events.
* Attend and support regularly scheduled operations meetings, facilitating communication between security, operations, and enterprise events when possible.
* Update all arrangement details in Artifax software to ensure Rental Events are listed accurately and are free of conflicts. Follow up on changes needed with Operations Manager.
* Understand, maintain, and complete centralized schedule activities in Asana.
* Contribute to event planning, scheduling, and on\-site event management support for the wider Events team, as requested.

### **Qualifications \& Skills**

* College degree desired, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of event coordination experience required.
* Experience in customer relations is essential.
* Experience with Microsoft Office 365 is required.
* Experience with intra\-departmental communications within large organizations strongly desired.
* Previous experience in a museum setting is desired.
* Experience with venue management software and project management software, like Asana, is a plus.

### **Working Conditions**


* Must be able to lift and carry at least 35 lbs.
* Must be able to work flexible hours onsite, including nights, weekends, and early mornings.
* Must be able to remain on your feet for extended periods during event shifts
$30\.01/hour (starting); $36\.02/hour (position)

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Merchant Onboarding and Experience on the DoorDash for Business
jobs.description:
**About The Team**
------------------



DoorDash for Business is building the premier corporate dining and benefits platform—helping companies of all sizes feed their teams through industry\-leading products and meal programs. Our mission is to become the go\-to solution for executives, administrators, and employees who need seamless, high\-quality food programs at work. We move fast, operate with an ownership mindset, and are growing new product lines to better serve our corporate customers.



Merchant success is core to that mission. When merchants have a clear, fast, and high\-quality path from interest to live, our products work better for everyone—customers, Dashers, and the merchants themselves.


**About The Role**
------------------



As Associate Manager, Merchant Onboarding and Experience on the DoorDash for Business team, you will own how merchants get onto our programs and how they feel while they do it. You will be the lead for onboarding process design, execution quality, and merchant experience—turning a complex, multi\-step journey into something that is faster, clearer, and consistently excellent.



Your responsibilities will range from strategic (mapping the end\-to\-end onboarding journey, setting the operating model, and aligning Product, Ops, Sales, and Support on what "great" looks like) to operational (diagnosing drop\-off, tightening handoffs, building playbooks, and using data and automation to remove friction). You will bring a systems mindset: every broken step is a process to redesign, every merchant complaint is a signal, and every manual workaround is a candidate for a better workflow. You will report into the DoorDash for Business Merchant Experience team.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will be driving…**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


**Onboarding Process Ownership**



Own the end\-to\-end merchant onboarding journey—from first intake through go\-live. Map the current\-state workflow, identify bottlenecks and failure points, and redesign the process so merchants get live faster with fewer drop\-offs, fewer handoffs, and clearer ownership at every step.


**Merchant Experience**



Define what a great onboarding experience looks like and hold the organization to it. Set the standard for communication, expectations, time\-to\-live, and quality of setup so merchants feel guided, not managed. Close the loop from merchant feedback and escalations back into the process.


**Operational Excellence**



Build the operating rhythm for onboarding—SLAs, stage definitions, playbooks, exception handling, and quality checks. Make the funnel measurable and visible so the team can see where merchants stall and why.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**



Work closely with Sales, Account Management, Operations, Product, Support, Menu, and Partnerships to drive alignment on onboarding requirements, reduce back\-and\-forth, and support better decision\-making. You are the connective tissue across teams that touch the merchant during launch.


**Data, Insights, and Continuous Improvement**



Analyze onboarding funnels, cycle times, drop\-off, rework, and post\-launch health to find the highest\-leverage fixes. Turn messy operational data into recommendations leadership can act on. Track whether process changes actually improve merchant experience and time\-to\-value.


**Automation and Tooling**



Identify manual, repetitive, or poorly instrumented steps in onboarding and replace them with better workflows, tooling, and AI\-assisted processes. You will not just document the process—you will help build the systems that make it run.


**We're Excited About You Because You Have…**
---------------------------------------------


* 4–6\+ years of experience in merchant/partner operations, onboarding, customer or merchant success, marketplace operations, or a similar role at a high\-growth marketplace, logistics, or SaaS company. Experience at a top\-tier consulting firm is a plus.
* A bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Economics, or a related field.
* Proven experience owning an operational process end\-to\-end—mapping workflows, diagnosing bottlenecks, and shipping changes that improved conversion, cycle time, or customer/merchant experience.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate messy operational reality into a clear story for merchants, operators, and executives.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a systems mindset. You are comfortable in ambiguity, you default to ownership, and you can move between strategy and the details of how work actually gets done.

We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it.

Engineers make million\-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. jobs.title: Data Center Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

  

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

  

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will own the technical and commercial vetting that turns a raw deal into a fundable project — the work that separates a defensible capacity commitment from an inflated one. When a partner asks Crux to guarantee an eight\- or nine\-figure sum, you're the one who tests that number against schedule, equipment composition, and real construction cost before it goes to leadership. Reporting into the Chief Program Manager's organization, you will sit at the interface between Data Center Construction, Energy, MEP, and Finance, making sure every project in the active portfolio is executed against the numbers it was approved on — and flagging it immediately when it isn't.

**In this role, you will:**

* Vet the technical and commercial terms of new capacity deals — schedule, equipment cost, equipment composition — before they're recommended to leadership, right\-sizing commitments rather than defaulting to the number a partner asks for.
* Track every live data center project in the portfolio against its approved cost and schedule baseline, and own the process for flagging and escalating variance early.
* Partner with Data Center Construction, Energy, and MEP Systems teams to translate field\-level execution status into Finance\-ready program reporting.
* Own the interface between build\-side execution and the cost and margin model of record — your data is what Finance's models are actually built on.
* Run the change\-control process for scope, schedule, or cost changes on active projects, with sign\-off gates that keep Finance and Development aligned in real time.
* Build and maintain the tools that make deal vetting fast and repeatable — this cannot be a one\-off analysis redone from scratch on every deal.
* Default to AI\-agentic workflows for cost/schedule reconciliation and variance tracking, rather than adding headcount to keep up with portfolio growth.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Deal\-vetting framework (schedule, equipment cost, composition) is documented and applied to at least one live negotiation.
* Portfolio cost/schedule tracking is live for the current active project set.

**After 6 months:**

* Variance escalation process is running with a documented track record of catching at\-risk projects before they slip.
* Finance's cost and margin model of record is being fed directly from your tracking, not reconstructed separately.

**After 1 year:**

* Deal\-vetting and portfolio\-tracking functions run as a repeatable system others can execute against, not a one\-person effort.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 8\+ years in data center construction, capital projects, or infrastructure delivery with direct P\&L, cost, or schedule ownership.
* Demonstrated experience vetting or negotiating capacity/commercial terms against real technical and cost data, not top\-down assumptions.
* Comfortable moving fluently across finance, construction, and technology — this is not a single\-lane specialist seat.

**Attributes**

* “$900M is the ask” is a hypothesis until the equipment and schedule say otherwise — you test the number before you defend it.
* You bring bad news first, unprompted, and own the result — hierarchy doesn't intimidate you and you don't intimidate easily either.

**Mindset**

* High tolerance for ambiguity. The portfolio will outgrow whatever process exists today, and you build the next version rather than waiting for one.
* AI\-agentic first. Fluent with AI agents — or committed to becoming so quickly — and you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process.

**Nice to have (preferred, not required)**

* Background in data center construction, controllership, or capital\-projects finance specialized in the build environment.
* Experience with direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling, Level 5/IST commissioning, or other GW\-scale data center technical scope.
* Neocloud or hyperscaler experience (CoreWeave, Nebius, Nscale, Lambda, Google, AWS, Meta, Microsoft) in a program or delivery management capacity.
* Formal cost engineering, quantity surveying, or construction finance credential.

**Salary Range Information**


The annual salary range for this position has been estimated based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

**About Crux**

* We offer generous base, bonus and additional incentive based compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* Company\-paid life insurance and disability

jobs.title: Senior NPI Project Manager
jobs.description:
**The Company**


Halo Industries has invented a revolutionary technology to replace a decades\-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser\-based technology eliminates waste, improves material cost and performance, and drives advancements in high\-growth markets like automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo is well\-funded and poised for rapid growth, engaging strategic customers and preparing for volume manufacturing.

**The Opportunity**


The evolution of Halo’s technology and equipment, growing from an R\&D focus to a production manufacturing environment, has triggered the need for a Sr. NPI Project Manager who can help to coordinate the successful transition of its equipment manufacturing from the R\&D engineering team to the NPI equipment build team.

**Job Description**


The Sr. NPI Project Manager will coordinate the transfer of equipment build responsibilities to the NPI team and the timely and successful deployment of that equipment into production. Responsibilities include:

* Manage detailed project schedules, risk registers, and status reports for equipment builds
* Define project deliverables for NPI engineers, allocate and track tasks, and closely monitor progress
* Proactively identify and overcome obstacles to timely delivery of equipment and knowledge transfer. This requires hands\-on, detailed involvement in the daily work of the NPI engineering team.
* Coordinate cross\-functional collaboration to transfer knowledge, processes, and documents between the R\&D engineering and NPI teams
* Manage the NPI technical writing team’s development of all documents required for this transfer
* Drive PLM phase gate readiness for product design and production release
* Aid in determining the product or system requirements
* Drive continuous improvement in NPI processes, equipment, and tooling
* Coordinate the bringup of NPI equipment in halo’s international volume fabrication facilities
* Present project status to the Halo management team and participate in strategic planning activity

  

**Requirements** **Education \& Experience**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Material Science, Physics, or related discipline
* A minimum of 4 years of NPI project management experience for complex engineering systems, preferably in the semiconductor industry
* Experience transitioning products from prototype to production/manufacturing scale
* Experience leading teams comprising 5 to 10 NPI engineers

**What We’re Looking For**

* High proficiency with modern project management tools and collaborative productivity tools
* Strong detail\-oriented organizational skills
* Strong technical communication skills with the capability to lead and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team and communicate status to all stakeholders
* Ability to work effectively in a highly dynamic environment where priorities and schedules are subject to change
* Ownership mentality, with ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to build and sustain cooperative working relationships with managers, colleagues, and external partners
* Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems

**Bonus**

* Experience with Arena PLM, Jira, Confluence, and Google Workspace applications (particularly Google Sheets)
* Project management certification (e.g., PMP)
* Experience in startup environments

  

**Benefits** ***Benefits***

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Free Food \& Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* Annual Bonus Plan eligible
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability

***Additional Information***


We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.


Base salary range: $140k \- $160k

### **Position Summary**



We are seeking a highly organized Assistant Project Manager to support delivery of a cargo facility relocation project at San Francisco International Airport (SFO). Working with project leadership, this role will help coordinate scope, design, permitting, budget, schedule, documentation, construction activities, and stakeholder requirements from planning through closeout. The position requires a proactive project professional who can maintain accurate controls, follow open items through resolution, and support multiple concurrent activities in an active airport environment.



Note: This opportunity is available at multiple levels. Final placement will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience, skills, and alignment with business needs. We are committed to providing fair and equitable consideration for all applicants.



### **Organizational Responsibilities**

* Maintain project controls and documentation, including scope information, deliverables, actions, decisions, risks, milestones, and other items requiring follow\-up.
* Support design and permitting activities by coordinating stakeholder reviews, tracking comments, and following submissions, agency responses, and approvals through resolution.
* Assist with project financial management, including budgets, forecasts, commitments, potential changes, and related tracking.
* Organize project meetings and maintain agendas, minutes, decisions, and action\-item follow\-up.
* Coordinate requirements and interfaces with cargo operations, facilities, IT, security, and other affected stakeholders.
* Participate in site walks and support construction administration by documenting conditions and constraints and tracking RFIs, submittals, procurement items, and contractor coordination.
* Assist with commissioning, turnover, record documentation, and closeout activities.
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of relevant project management or project coordination experience supporting commercial, industrial, aviation, or similar capital projects.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related technical discipline required.
* Experience supporting projects through design, permitting, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain project budgets, schedules, controls, documentation, and multiple concurrent action items.
* Experience working in an active airport or similarly complex operational environment with strong stakeholder\-coordination and communication skills.
* Cargo, logistics, warehouse, or airline\-support\-facility project experience preferred.
* Prior SFO or airline project experience preferred.
* Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Bluebeam, or construction/project management platforms preferred.
* Experience supporting phased construction or projects within occupied operational facilities preferred.

* Weekend work is rare but occasionally may be necessary

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

* Must communicate frequently with other departments and employees both verbally and in writing.

Cognitive: Problem\-solving, written, and verbal communication skills; computer and software skills; and ability to read and interpret text online or in printed form.

jobs.title: Enterprise Project Manager II (Temporary)
jobs.description:
**OUR COMMITMENT TO A HUMAN HIRING PROCESS**



We believe every candidate deserves thoughtful consideration. That's why we do not use AI or automated systems to review applications. Every application is reviewed by a real human member of our team. Because we take the time to give each submission the attention it deserves, our review process may take a little longer — and we genuinely appreciate your patience as we work through applications carefully and respectfully.


**SERVICE AREA PREFERENCE**



While we encourage all interested applicants to apply, we do give priority to those who live in, or near, our service counties: Santa Cruz, Monterey, Merced, San Benito, and Mariposa. Our mission of *accessible, quality health care guided by local innovation*leads everything we do, and having team members who are connected to the communities we serve strengthens our ability to deliver on that commitment.


#### **ABOUT THIS TEMP POSITION**



This is a temporary position and is available remotely for those residing in California. The length of the assignment is estimated to go from September 2026 through December 2026, but this is always dependent on business need, and these dates may change. While the assignment would be at the Alliance, you would be an employee of a temporary employment agency that we would connect you with if hired for this position.This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) temporary assignment.


**WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**



Reporting to the Enterprise Project Management Manager, this position:


* Provides intermediate\-level project management support for medium to high complexity cross\-functional, systems\-driven strategic and operational projects involving interdepartmental units and/or external stakeholder teams through all aspects of the project lifecycle
* Conducts intermediate\-level business, technical and financial analysis and reporting to support operations and business development
* Effectively utilizes, implements and communicates project management methodologies and policies, and mentors project teams, project stakeholders and Enterprise Project Managers, to ensure accuracy, consistency and thoroughness

  


**ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Project Management Office (PMO) is a key part of our Operational Excellence Department, committed to *providing and growing operational effectiveness expertise across the organization*. As the PMO team, we contribute to that commitment through enterprise Portfolio, Program and Project Management services, enabling the organization to operationally adapt and advance our mission. The PMO's role is to provide practical structure, partnership, and support that makes it easier for teams to deliver meaningful outcomes and focus on what matters most: serving our members well.

  


**IDEAL CANDIDATE**



We are looking for a flexible, adaptable professional who works effectively with stakeholders at all levels and keeps projects moving in a fast\-paced environment. This person communicates clearly, collaborates across teams, and manages the full project lifecycle with strong organization and attention to detail. They are resourceful and solution oriented, able to balance multiple priorities while producing high\-quality documentation. They take ownership of their work, build trust and credibility quickly, foster alignment across teams, and contribute to team success with a constructive, team\-first approach.

  


#### **WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**

  



To read the full position description and list of requirements, click here.


* **Knowledge of:**
* + Project management methodologies and tools
	+ Windows based PC systems and Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and project management software applications
	+ Methods and tools of meeting facilitation and ability to lead team building exercises and facilitate meetings and/or projects using problem solving and persuasion skills
* **Ability to:**
	+ Demonstrate strong analytical skills and identify issues, offer solutions and mitigate risk
	+ Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner
	+ Maintain organized and accurate records
	+ Accurately collect, interpret and evaluate data, make recommendations, and project consequences of recommendations
	+ Prepare statistical and narrative reports
* **Education and Experience:**
	+ Bachelor's degree in a Business, Health Care or a related field
	+ A minimum of three years of project management experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be qualifying

#### **OTHER INFORMATION**


* We are in a hybrid work environment, and we anticipate that the interview process will take place remotely via Microsoft Teams.
* While some staff may work full telecommuting schedules, attendance at quarterly company\-wide events or department meetings will be expected.
* In\-office or in\-community presence may be required for some positions and is dependent on business need. Details about this can be reviewed during the interview process.
* **This is a temporary position and does not provide the benefits that are listed below (this is standard language from our regular job posts and cannot be altered or removed). Temporary employees on assignment at the Alliance will be connected to a staffing agency with separate benefit options.**


**COMPENSATION INFORMATION**


* **Zone 1 Pay Range: $57\.70 \- $63\.50**  

Typical areas in Zone 1: Santa Cruz, San Benito, and Monterey Counties, Bay Area, Sacramento, Los Angeles and San Diego areas
* **Zone 2 Pay Range: $54\.50 \- $60\.10**  

Typical areas in Zone 2: Mariposa and Merced Counties, Fresno area, Bakersfield, Eastern California, San Luis Obispo area, and the Central Valley (except Sacramento)


The applicable salary ranges are based on work location and are aligned to a zone according to the cost of labor in your area. All ranges are subject to change in the future. We are happy to answer any questions that you have or share the applicable pay zone for your lo

jobs.title: Program Manager- NPI
jobs.description:
As NPI Program Manager, you will serve as the primary leader for assigned customer programs and portfolios, driving the execution of customer commitments, operational performance, and business objectives. You will align resources across Molex GSM, translate customer requirements into executable plans, and lead cross\-functional teams through demand planning, delivery, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Account Management, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain \& Operations, Procurement, and Sales, you will ensure priorities, risks, and decisions are effectively managed to support customer success and profitable growth.
Success in this role requires strong business acumen, customer advocacy, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization to drive accountability, disciplined execution, and measurable results. The Program Manager is accountable for overall program performance and customer satisfaction, ensuring alignment between customer priorities and business objectives.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead cross\-functional execution of customer programs and projects, managing priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions to ensure successful delivery of customer and business objectives.
* Serve as the primary program leader and internal customer advocate, aligning customer priorities, contractual commitments, and business objectives with operational capabilities and resources.
* Establish and maintain program governance, including customer reviews, executive business reviews, escalation management, action tracking, performance reporting, and recovery planning.
* Translate customer demand, forecasts, program changes, and strategic priorities into coordinated plans that support delivery, quality, responsiveness, and profitable growth.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate risks while facilitating timely, data\-driven decision\-making to prevent impacts to customer experience or business performance.
* Develop and maintain program plans, dashboards, performance metrics, and communication processes that provide visibility, accountability, and execution discipline.
* Partner with commercial and operational leaders to support strategic account planning, identify growth opportunities, improve forecast accuracy, and protect profitability.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including on\-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, customer satisfaction, and program profitability.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 2\+ years of experience leading programs, projects, customer accounts, or cross\-functional business initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across matrixed organizations, manage risk, balance competing priorities, and drive execution without direct authority.
* Strong business, financial, analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills, including experience leading customer communications, escalations, and performance reviews.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, ERP/MRP systems, business intelligence tools, and performance reporting dashboards.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience leading strategic customer programs in aerospace, defense, space, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting strategic account growth, new program launches, demand planning, and manufacturing operations.
* Experience presenting to executive leadership, leading customer business reviews, and building strong customer relationships while balancing business and operational priorities.
* PMP, PgMP, Lean Six Sigma, or comparable project management and continuous improvement certifications.

jobs.title: Residential Project Manager
jobs.description:
Nordin Builders is a small, family\-run residential general contractor looking for a Project Manager to join our team. We build and remodel homes throughout Los Altos, Los Altos Hills, Palo Alto, Mountain View, Woodside and surrounding areas.

This is a hybrid role, but the majority of the position is spent onsite. We’re looking for someone who understands residential construction, can confidently read plans, knows construction sequencing and is comfortable managing the day\-to\-day moving pieces of a project.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day progress of residential projects
* Coordinate subcontractors, inspections, deliveries and materials
* Read architectural and structural plans and oversee work in the field
* Maintain project schedules and stay ahead of upcoming trades and project needs
* Communicate with homeowners, architects, designers, subcontractors and our internal team
* Identify issues in the field and work with the team to resolve them
* Manage project documentation such as change orders and punch lists
* Keep project information organized and up to date in Buildertrend and Google Drive

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong knowledge of residential construction and how a project comes together from start to finish
* Very good at reading and understanding construction plans
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing and trade coordination
* Organized, dependable and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces
* Strong communication and follow\-through
* Comfortable with technology and proficient with Google Drive, Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Calendar
* Buildertrend experience is a plus, but not required

We’re flexible on exact background and experience. Residential project management experience is a plus, but strong field experience, construction knowledge and the ability to stay organized and manage a project are most important to us.

Because we’re a small team, this person will work closely with both our field and office staff and have a lot of involvement in their projects.

* **Full\-time \| Monday–Friday**
* **Primarily onsite with some remote flexibility**
* **Compensation based on experience**

Pay: From $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company truck
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R\&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice\-of\-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.


This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross\-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.


This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy**

* Run structured voice\-of\-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
* Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
* Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

**Architecture and AI Deployment**

* Own end\-to\-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
* Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well\-governed capability that scales across divisions.
* Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
* Track adoption and usage post\-deployment, and course\-correct programs that aren't landing.

**Automation Program Execution**

* Lead program management for cross\-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
* Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
* Manage cross\-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

**Cross\-Functional Governance and Reporting**

* Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
* Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross\-program dependencies.
* Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10\+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R\&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
* Systems engineering background or hands\-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
* Experience running voice\-of\-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
* Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
* Experience running cross\-divisional or multi\-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems\-level and architecture workflows.
* Skilled at running voice\-of\-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
* Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
* Strong cross\-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Creative Ops
jobs.description:
**Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!**
---------------------------------------------


Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.


As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.


We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

**Role**
--------


We’re looking for a Senior Creative Operations Program Manager to lead large, high\-visibility campaigns across the Whatnot brand. This person will sit at the center of Creative, Marketing, and Catex teams, bringing structure to complex initiatives, aligning stakeholders, and keeping work moving from kickoff through launch. You’ll manage multiple priorities at once, anticipate risks, and ensure the team has the clarity and resources needed to deliver great creative work.


What You’ll Own:

* **Campaign program leadership.** Lead multiple complex, high\-visibility campaigns from kickoff through launch. Build clear project plans that align stakeholders around scope, milestones, owners, approvals, dependencies, and deliverables.
* **Prioritization and resourcing.** Partner with creative leadership to evaluate incoming requests, sequence work, and focus the team on the highest\-impact priorities. Maintain a clear view of capacity and flag when timelines, scope, or resources need to shift.
* **Cross\-functional alignment and decision\-making.** Bring Creative, Marketing, and partner teams together around shared goals and clear expectations. Lead working sessions and reviews that drive timely decisions, establish ownership, and keep work moving.
* **Communication and relationship building.** Build trust through clear, thoughtful communication tailored to different audiences. Navigate complex interpersonal dynamics with empathy and confidence while contributing to a collaborative, solutions\-oriented team culture.
* **Risk and dependency management.** Anticipate challenges, identify critical dependencies, and surface tradeoffs early. Resolve blockers before they put timelines, budgets, or creative quality at risk.
* **Creative operations and ways of working.** Build and refine practical workflows that make it easier for the team to collaborate and deliver great work. Introduce the right amount of structure without creating unnecessary process or slowing the team down.
* **Program visibility and measurement.** Create a clear view of what’s in flight, what’s at risk, and where decisions are needed. Define success, track progress and outcomes, and apply learnings to make future programs stronger.

 **We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in\-person time for planning, problem\-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our San Francisco, Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York City hubs.**

**You**
-------


People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they’re building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it.


For this role specifically, you should have:

* 6\+ years of experience in creative, marketing, or design program management, ideally at a high\-growth consumer company, marketplace, or creator\-focused platform. You’ve worked closely with Creative, Marketing, and GTM teams from early planning through final delivery.
* A track record of leading complex, integrated campaigns. You’ve successfully managed large\-scale brand initiatives with multiple workstreams, stakeholders, deliverables, and dependencies, bringing structure to the work without slowing it down.
* Strong creative production fluency. You understand how creative work moves from brief and concept through reviews, production, and launch. You know what teams need to do their best work and can build realistic timelines around the creative process.
* Exceptional prioritization and project management instincts. You can separate urgent from important, assess tradeoffs, and translate shifting priorities into a clear plan. You’re highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to keep several initiatives moving at once.
* Clear communication and strong relationship\-building skills. You can turn messy information, competing opinions, and complex blockers into clear recommendations.
* Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You operate independently, identify what needs to happen next, and move work forward without waiting for perfect direction. When a problem arises, you bring practical solutions—not just the problem.
* Operational and analytical judgment. You use data to identify issues, measure progress, and improve how teams work. You’re comfortable managing vendors and contractors and adapting project management, resourcing, and reporting tools to fit the team’s needs.

**Benefits**
------------

jobs.title: NPI Procurement Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.


At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**


We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled NPI Materials Planner to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in the management of Bill of Materials (BOM), working within Product Life Cycles, and understanding the complexities of logistics, manufacturing operations, and supply chain constraints to ensure on time delivery. This individual will be responsible for coordinating with engineering, NPI (New Product Introduction) teams, volume manufacturing teams, and working within the supply chain organization to ensure smooth and efficient materials procurement and management. The role requires someone who can manage multiple products and programs simultaneously at various stages, while ensuring documentation accuracy, compliance with regulations, and vendor performance metrics management.**What You Can Expect**

* **Supplier and Vendor Relations:** Collaborate with supply chain managers, vendors, and contract manufacturers to provide routine forecasts, and ensure accurate and timely procurement. Monitor vendor performance metrics such as lead times and order accuracy to ensure high standards of material delivery and quality. Day to Day point person with all suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* **Bill of Materials (BOM) Management:** Oversee the management of Bills of Materials (BOM) for various projects and programs across different stages of development. Ensure that all BOMs are accurate, complete, and properly aligned with product specifications.
* **Product Life Cycle Management:** Work with engineering and NPI teams to support products from the design phase through production release, ensuring smooth transitions between phases and managing materials throughout the product lifecycle.
* **Forecasting and Inventory Control:** Provide accurate and timely forecasts to vendors based on current and future needs. Track and manage inventory levels, including parts, components, and assemblies, to ensure that manufacturing processes run smoothly without material shortages or excess stock.
* **Compliance and Documentation:** Ensure compliance with all regulations (e.g., environmental, safety) and maintain accurate records of transactions related to material purchases, shipments, and returns. Monitor and uphold company documentation standards for all procurement and material\-related processes.
* **Multi\-Tasking and Project Coordination:** Effectively manage multiple products and programs at different stages, balancing competing priorities and working collaboratively across departments, including engineering, NPI, finance, and supply chain.
* **Procurement and Purchase Orders:** Supervise the procurement process for various projects, including overseeing commodity purchases, pursuing multi\-source solutions, and ensuring the timely and cost\-effective acquisition of materials.
* **Vendor Management and Performance Monitoring:** Monitor vendor performance metrics and collaborate with vendors to resolve any issues related to lead times, order accuracy, and material quality. Work to improve vendor relationships and performance over time.

jobs.title: Digital Accessibility Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Please note:** We will consider both Hybrid and Remote candidates for this role.


The Digital Accessibility Program Manager serves as the operational and subject matter backbone to the Office of Digital Accessibility’s service delivery. This role owns the day\-to\-day functioning of the digital accessibility program in managing the service portfolio, conducting accessibility evaluations, ensuring the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of accessibility reviews from team members, engaging directly with campus clients on complex compliance challenges, and tracking program performance. The Digital Accessibility Program Manager reports to the Director for the Office of Digital Accessibility.


The ideal candidate brings both digital accessibility expertise and strong program management skills, serving as a critical bridge between technical staff and Stanford clients by translating findings, balancing competing priorities, and ensuring clients leave every engagement with clear, actionable guidance. They are equally comfortable guiding a campus web team through a remediation roadmap, reviewing an engineer's audit report for accuracy and completeness, and prioritizing and managing competing tasks with concurrent deadlines.


**Core Duties:**

**Program Management:**

* Manage the digital accessibility service intake pipeline by triaging incoming requests, assigning work, tracking progress, and ensuring reviews and consultations are completed on schedule.
* Coordinate with Office of Digital Accessibility staff on workload planning, deadline management, and service delivery priorities.
* Maintain quality standards for digital accessibility deliverables and consult with digital accessibility engineers on complex findings or edge cases requiring additional interpretation. Ensure findings are presented in a manner that is solution\-focused and actionable for both technical and non\-technical clients.
Oversee the interpretation, implementation and compliance with digital accessibility standards and regulations. Recommend actions and/or resolve complex issues with institutional partners that span organizational and university boundaries.  
* 

**Program Evaluation:**

* Evaluate how existing accessibility tools are offered and based on configuration, adoption, and use, if they are meeting program goals or when alternatives should be considered.
* Identify trends in accessibility issues across campus and surface insights that inform strategy and resource planning.
In coordination with the Director, track and maintain key performance indicators and program metrics, including service volume, review turnaround times, client satisfaction, remediation outcomes, and compliance trends.  
* 

**Planning and Analysis:**

* Under supervision of the Director, execute strategic plans for the Office of Digital Accessibility, leveraging subject matter expertise to meet regulatory and technical challenges for digital accessibility.
* Design and evolve the digital accessibility service delivery model, determining how core services (e.g., audit intake, remediation consultation, procurement review, training) are structured and delivered to improve client experiences.
Apply a creative mindset and bring the ability to think outside the box to create innovative service offerings.  
* 

**Client Management:**

* Advise clients on how accessibility requirements should be applied to specific vendor evaluations while balancing the intersection of technical standards, compliance obligations, and institutional constraints.
* Support clients on complex compliance requirements, including situations requiring creative or non\-standard solutions.
* Navigate difficult conversations with stakeholders who are resistant to or overwhelmed by accessibility requirements.
* Translate technical remediation findings into actionable guidance for non\-technical content owners, developers, and procurement staff.

  
**Core Duties** :


* Lead strategic planning and analysis for complex functions or programs with significant business, regulatory and/or technical challenges requiring subject matter expertise. May provide development of program or function from initial concept to implementation.
* Manage the administration and evaluation of programs or functions. Oversee the interpretation, implementation and compliance with policies and regulations. Recommend actions and/or resolve complex issues that often span organizational boundaries.
* Represent the program or function at the university level and/or to external/internal stakeholders and constituencies.
* Develop and manage outreach strategy that includes relationship development, communications, and compliance.
* Oversee or supervise staff in the development and implementation of programs or functions.
May develop and/or oversee budgets; manage finances including monitoring, analyzing, forecasting, and reporting.  
* 

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree and eight years of relevant experience, or combination of education and relevant experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to influence and motivate constituencies which could span multiple organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated excellent planning, organizational and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated ability to make sound business decisions using good business judgment and innovative and creative problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to manage financial, organizational and staff resources.
* Excellent interpersonal and communications skills with the ability to cultivate professional and business partnerships.
* Relevant subject matter expertise.

jobs.title: NPI Eng Program Manager, Devices Return Services
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Role:  

As a Engineering Program Manager within the Hardware Service Engineering team you are responsible for defining the customer facing and internal strategy for the warranty and returns services of a new complex product. In addition to creating the overall returns service strategy, the role owns development of technical processes for dis\-assembly, assembly, spare parts reclamation, and development of tooling solutions to facilitate service operations.  

  

This includes defining, developing, deploying and sustaining hardware screening operations and repair/refurbishment processes globally to support Amazon Digital Device products. The role will be expected to use program management experience to share the overall strategy, gain cross\-functional support, and hold stakeholders accountable to the overall Reverse Logistics NPI strategy.  

  

In this role, you will:  

1\. Conduct detailed technical review and assessment of hardware designs at different product development phases, and drive design\-for\-serviceability (DFS) decisions during product concept and architecture phases that ensure component accessibility, modular assembly, and repair\-friendly layouts to optimize serviceability outcomes.  

2\. Provide actionable, engineering\-driven feedback on hardware design features during product development with a focus on design\-for\-serviceability (DFS).  

3\. Own the repair service cost\-model, making appropriate trade\-offs to optimize cost and quality  

4\. Own defining customer return screening and repair strategy for warranty and remorse returns  

5\. Design and develop customer return screening and repair processes that optimize cost and product recovery  

6\. Apply Design of Experiment (DOE) methods to design and launch repeatable and reliable repair processes  

7\. Own defining and delivering key end customer facing outputs including customer facing repair documentation, repair service offerings, and spare parts offerings.  

8\. Partner with suppliers and manufacturers to validate that tooling, test fixtures, and service solutions align with product support requirements, warranty cost targets, and product launch schedules.  

9\. Develop programs to reduce the need for new spare parts through refurbishment of previous used parts and for improvements on warranty costs  

10\. Develop repair processes for continued improvements on efficiency and reduced complexity in the operations  

11\. Travel Required up to 20% (Domestic and International)  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Assess risk to service and repair customer offerings for new products beginning at concept.
* Enable closed loop feedback to product design and product management.
* Identify opportunities to improve the design for serviceability, design for repairability and go to market (GTM) strategy for aftermarket support and pre\-owned sales of Amazon Devices.
* Measure cost of service and repair against financial targets.

  

A day in the life  

As the overall owner of the NPI process within Reverse Logistics, on a daily basis, you will work with a broad cross\-functional team responsible for launching some of our most complex products. Your day will likely begin with updates from the European and Asian stakeholders for product launch. Then you will focus on documenting the plan of record for service and repair, with special focus on identifying serviceability and repairability improvement opportunities to reduce overall service and repair costs. Using your knowledge of repair processes you will submit requests for design changes to product design. To end your day you will work with product management, customer service, and SW tech teams to scope new customer facing service offerings required for the new Amazon product.
  

  

About the team  

Devices Return Services owns global warranty and services for all Amazon Device products. The team's vision is to power the circular economy by giving consumer electronic products another chance to be loved.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent
* 2\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with hardware/software integration and real\-time systems
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams to deliver products and online services on tight deadlines
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
* Experience in Reverse Logistics, Service Engineering, Product Design or Manufacturing Tooling and Process Development.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
