**POSITION TITLE:** Project Manager


**LOCATION:** Remote


**CLEARANCE:** Must be able to obtain a High\-Risk Public Trust

  


**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

  



At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission\-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. Our expertise spans AI/ML, data architecture, low\-code/no\-code development, Agile DevSecOps, and cloud services, delivering scalable and meaningful solutions.



In our Emerging Technology Lab, innovation drives progress. Our teams create intelligent chatbots, AI\-powered assistants, robotic process automation (RPA), essay graders, and data analytics platforms. If you’re passionate about solving complex challenges and shaping the future, APV is the place for you. Since 2007, we’ve partnered with federal and state agencies to deliver IT, training, and consulting solutions that achieve mission\-critical outcomes. Built on accountability, integrity, and quality, we go beyond expectations. With 70\+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

  


**At APV, we Always Provide Value**

  


**POSITION SUMMARY**

  



The Project Manager (PM) will provide overall leadership, coordination, and accountability for delivery of FDA/CDER optional shared services. The PM will serve as the primary management interface with the FDA COR and Project Manager and will integrate technical workstreams, staffing, schedule, quality, risk, reporting, knowledge management, and transition activities to ensure timely, consistent, and uninterrupted support to FDA reviewers.

  

**DUTIES**

  


* Lead day\-to\-day task order management across Clinical Services, Nonclinical Services, and optional shared\-service activities; maintain clear accountability among technical leads and delivery staff.
* Develop and maintain the Project Management Plan, integrated schedule, work breakdown structure, work plan, milestones, quality assurance approach, and management processes for risk, change, configuration, communications, and requirements.
* Establish intake, prioritization, resource assignment, workload balancing, escalation, and monitoring processes so recurring and customized analytical requests meet agreed milestones and service expectations.
* Coordinate the project kickoff, recurring FDA status meetings, agendas, minutes, action items, decisions, and follow\-up activities; communicate emerging risks, dependencies, staffing constraints, and corrective actions.
* Manage monthly status and financial reporting, task/CLIN performance, deliverable tracking, metrics, capacity utilization, and trend analysis; support FDA leadership with ad hoc data calls and management information.
* Oversee project and knowledge\-management repositories, including controlled storage of datasets, scripts, logs, outputs, lessons learned, procedures, and program documentation in FDA\-designated systems.
* Direct transition\-in and transition\-out activities, including onboarding, access/badging coordination, incumbent knowledge transfer, shadowing, documentation transfer, and maintenance of service continuity.
* Coordinate staffing and surge coverage across multidisciplinary personnel, including clinical and nonclinical SMEs, data standards specialists, statistical/data programmers, biostatisticians, analysts, and technical resources.

  


**EDUCATION**

  


* Bachelor’s degree in business, science, health, information technology, engineering, data/analytics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred

  


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  


* 7\+ years of progressive project/program management experience, including leadership of multidisciplinary technical, data, scientific, or analytical service teams in a regulated or mission\-critical environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing schedules, staffing, risk/issues, quality, reporting, stakeholder communications, deliverables, and fixed\-price or performance\-based work.
* Working knowledge of clinical/nonclinical data, regulatory review support, data standards, analytical programming, or scientific\-computing environments sufficient to coordinate technical SMEs and communicate effectively with FDA stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal skills
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a High\-Risk Public Trust or equivalent federal client access. This role supports sensitive federal programs and involves elevated access to systems and data.
* Position requires the current ability to obtain and maintain required access without interruption in alignment with long\-term program needs.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  


* PMP or comparable certification; prior FDA/CDER, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or Federal health experience; familiarity with OCS reviewer\-support services, CDISC/SEND concepts, SAS/R/JMP/JMP Clinical, SharePoint, Jira or similar work\-management tools, and transition of incumbent analytical services.

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** NCCCP Project Coordinator  
**Reports to:** NCCCP Project Manager  
**Salary Range:** $61,000\-$66,000/year DOQ  
**Classification:** Full\-time, Exempt  
**Location:** Remote

**To Apply: A resume and cover letter detailing your interest in the position and relevant experience are required. Applications submitted without both will be automatically rejected**

**About AICAF**  
The American Indian Cancer Foundation (AICAF), a national nonprofit, is committed to supporting Native cancer patients, communities, tribal leaders, and healthcare providers with the knowledge and resources to improve cancer prevention, early detection, treatment, and survivorship outcomes across Indian Country. By educating and empowering, we can collectively work towards a cancer\-free future for our people and future generations.

**Position Summary**  
The NCCCP Project Coordinator position will focus primarily on the National Comprehensive Cancer Control Program (NCCCP), a nationwide initiative overseen by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Through this program, the American Indian Cancer Foundation (AICAF) works to advance comprehensive cancer control efforts by collaborating with Tribal Nations, Indigenous organizations, and partners to reduce the burden of cancer among American Indian and Alaska Native communities.

The NCCCP Project Coordinator will work closely with, and under the supervision of, the NCCCP Project Manager and will assist with the implementation of the NCCCP Program. As the NCCCP Project Coordinator you will assist with and support the project efforts that include but are not limited to: 1\) coalition building and facilitation, community engagement, collaboration, and buy\-in support with various entities, such as tribal, local, state, and national organizations; 2\) the development and dissemination of culturally tailored materials and messaging; 3\) knowledge of traditional tobacco practices; 4\) the ability to implement activities and strategies to support positive outcomes; and 5\) familiarity and capacity to understand and implement policy, systems, and environmental changes related to colorectal cancer, tobacco cessation, lung cancer, and survivorship.

Please Note: while the primary focus of this role involves this ongoing NCCCP Project, you may be asked to contribute to other tasks or projects, temporarily or permanently, as determined by organizational needs.

**Responsibilities**

* Work closely with the NCCCP Project Manager and as part of a team to review and establish program goals and deliverables, work plans, and timelines.
* Coordinate internal and external communications and maintain informative and respectful communications with various stakeholders (community partners, staff, coalition partners, consultants, and funders).
* Participate in the development and review of culturally tailored resources (educational materials, training and tools)
* Support the team in planning, tool development, recruitment, approvals, data collection, analysis, interpretation, and dissemination.
* Track all progress according to the deliverable deadlines and communicate project progress, needs, and potential issues via regular, timely updates.
* Deliver and share information with multiple audiences through written reports and verbal presentations (individual, group and web\-based).
* Work effectively as an AICAF team member through participation across organization initiatives.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**  
Education and Experience

* Degree in a health care field, such as public health, nursing, clinical health, or similar (Associate’s, Bachelor’s or Master’s).
* 2\+ years of experience with public health programs and working with AI/AN health systems and/or communities.

Skills and Abilities

* Interest and experience in the areas of cancer control with the ambition to learn more.
* Experience in planning and/or implementing quality improvement strategies in a virtual coalition setting.
* Experience in grant/contract management (planning, tracking, evaluation, and reporting).
* Solid understanding of evidence\-based cancer prevention and control strategies.
* Must be highly organized and self\-motivated and be able to prioritize and carry out concurrent projects on deadlines, manage complex projects, and carry out all responsibilities of the job requirements with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with demonstrated abilities in computer technology, report writing, facilitation, team collaboration, and public speaking.
* Sensitivity to cross\-cultural differences and ability to work effectively within diverse contexts, demonstrating discretion, tact, knowledge, judgment, and overall ability in working effectively with federal, state, tribal, and other professionals and facilitating participation and partnership in the activities of the program.
* Commitment to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and mission\-driven workplace culture.

**Sunny's Gourmet Products · Part\-time · Remote with travel to Mishawaka, Indiana**

Sunny's Gourmet Products manufactures authentic Korean sauces and seasonings — all\-natural, chef\-developed, and built on recipes our founder refined over more than thirty years, first in her own restaurant kitchen and now as a packaged goods line. We distribute nationally through KeHE, with UNFI in progress, alongside self\-distribution and Amazon, and hold retail placement across the Midwest and beyond.

**The opportunity**

This is a new role and a broad one. Our founder has run production directly since the beginning, and this next stage calls for formalizing what she has built — specifications, quality standards, supplier and cost systems — so it scales with us.

You would own that work end to end and design most of it rather than inherit it. For an operator who would rather build than maintain, there is real room here, and the role is structured to grow as the company does.

**The first six months**

*Month 1 — Get oriented.* Meet the team, learn the products, and map the current state across records, suppliers, contracts, certifications, and working arrangements. Deliver a current\-state map and a prioritized roadmap.

*Months 2–3 — On\-site intensive.* Two consecutive days in Mishawaka working directly with the founder and observing live production, capturing formulation, process parameters, and quality standards. A structured question bank and capture protocol are ready for you.

*Months 3–4 — Documentation.* Master specifications for four SKUs, quality standards with defined acceptance criteria, and core operating procedures.

*Months 4–6 — Build the operating record.* Supplier and packaging master with terms and lead times, SKU\-level cost build and COGS, logistics and fulfillment, and the compliance documentation our distribution partners require.

**Ongoing**

* Own and maintain the specification and procedure library
* Supplier relationships, purchasing cadence, and terms
* Cost tracking and margin analysis by SKU and channel
* Retailer and distributor compliance documentation and new item setup
* Co\-manufacturer qualification as we expand capacity
* Production planning and inventory as volume grows

**Required**

* Documentation experience in a regulated manufacturing environment — food, pharmaceutical, or medical device. Food preferred.
* Fluency in controlled documentation: specifications, batch records, operating procedures, and change control
* Experience building operating systems, not only maintaining them
* Experience working directly with a founder\-operator
* Self\-directed, and comfortable owning a function end to end

**Preferred**

* Food manufacturing background, particularly shelf\-stable products
* HACCP, GMP, and FSMA fluency
* Experience taking a small brand into co\-manufacturing
* Familiarity with KeHE and UNFI mechanics, trade spend, and deductions
* SKU\-level cost accounting
* Based in the South Bend–Elkhart area — convenient for the on\-site work, though not required

**Terms**

Independent contractor on a monthly retainer. Approximately 30 hours per month at $1,600–1,800, depending on experience and scope. Twelve\-month horizon with a path to a full\-time operations role as revenue supports it. Remote — on\-site work in Mishawaka is expected to be roughly 10% of the engagement or less, concentrated in the intensive. Airfare and lodging arranged and paid by SGP, ground transportation reimbursed. Mutual NDA prior to disclosure.

**To apply**

Send relevant experience with particular attention to operations work you built rather than inherited; one sample deliverable you authored (redaction is fine); your read on where you would start; and your availability.

Pay: $1,600\.00 \- $1,800\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Accounting Operations Manager
jobs.description:
FRINGE · REMOTE (US), OFFICE IN RICHMOND, VA · FULL\-TIME


**Accounting Operations Manager**


**About Fringe**


Fringe is a fast\-growing HR technology company based in Virginia. Founded in late 2018, Fringe is the first ever platform for personalized lifestyle benefits. We are a relentlessly people\-focused group revolutionizing the way employers care for their people in the benefits space. We're a supportive, down\-to\-earth team, fully committed to the belief that relationships fuel outstanding client experience.


We built Fringe to give companies a better way to show love and care to their people. Because we believe it's the people who really matter. Companies exist because of the products and services they offer, but we believe the people within them should come first. At Fringe, this is the way we live.


Practically, this means we hire people who care about their teammates just as much as (if not more than) themselves. We hire people who are genuine, humble, willing to learn, ready to teach, able to adapt, flex, collaborate, celebrate each other, win together and lose together.


We're a startup, and that means we must be a courageous group. We solve problems all day, but we also mess up sometimes. We extend grace to each other, and we try again. We aren't looking for perfect people. We're looking for people who own their faults, play to their strengths, and have the courage to simply be the same person all the time.


If that doesn't sound like your cup of cold brew, no hard feelings. But that's exactly who we are and what you can expect when you work at Fringe.


**About the role**


Fringe's employee experience platform combines a B2B model with a B2B2C marketplace. Employers pay us a subscription and fund lifestyle benefits, swag, recognition, and gifting for their people. Employees spend those dollars as points in our marketplace across hundreds of vendors. We pay the vendors. That means we run a SaaS business and a marketplace at the same time, with deferred revenue, points liabilities, and a cohort of channel partners layered on top. If you find that combination energizing rather than intimidating, keep reading.


You'll be the in\-house finance and accounting leader at Fringe and will take over a well\-built set of documented, repeatable close processes. You will own the monthly close and everything that comes out of it, run our financial operations end to end, and be the person everyone at Fringe comes to with a finance question. You'll report to the COO and work closely with Operations and Product.


This is a role for a professional who wants to jump into a startup environment and own a whole function. It is a lot of hats and it is a rare amount of scope, ownership, and visibility..


**What you'll own**


**Monthly close and reporting**


* Run the full monthly close: close calendar, journal entries, reconciliations, and sign\-off across subscription and marketplace revenue.
* Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 for a hybrid model: PEPM subscriptions, employer\-funded marketplace spend, gifting, and partner revenue share.
* Maintain deferred revenue and points liability roll\-forwards and keep the balance sheet clean and explainable.
* Produce internal and external monthly reporting: variance and flux analysis and the executive dashboard.
* Support the annual audit and tax processes with our outside CPA firms.


**Financial operations**


* Treasury and cash: cash forecast, bank relationships, managing operating balances, and executing outbound wires and ACH payments with proper approvals.
* Accounts payable, accounts receivable and collections in partnership with Customer Success: customer invoicing and billing accuracy, vendor payment runs, and chasing what's past due.
* Payroll, working with People Operations and our PEO.
* Review all accounting work and ensure a high standard.


**Cross\-functional partner**


* Be the main point of contact for all things finance internally: contract terms, vendor questions, funding schedules, commission plans, budgets.
* Spot the process that's slowing us down and fix it. Drive operational improvement rather than waiting for someone to ask.


**Who you are**


* High agency and a bias for action. You'd rather ship a good answer today than a perfect one next week, and you know which situations call for which.
* Comfortable being the only finance person in the room, and honest about when you need a second set of eyes.
* A clear communicator who can explain a flux to the CEO, a payment term to a salesperson, and a rev rec judgment to an auditor.
* Curious about how the business actually works, not just how it's booked.
* Someone who owns mistakes, extends grace, and shows up as the same person every day. That's who we are.


**Need to haves**


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience.
* Deep understanding of GAAP, especially ASC 606\.
* Hands\-on experience running monthly close procedures and meeting internal and external reporting requirements.
* Familiarity with an accounting tech stack and a spreadsheet wizard (Quickbooks, Tabs, Anrok, FloQast, Salesforce, Claude, Google Sheets)
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to drive operational improvement.
* Quality communicator, written and verbal.


**Nice to haves**


* Experience at Big 4, high\-growth startup, management consulting, or investment banking.
* CPA (active or license applicant).
* SaaS or marketplace experience, especially with deferred revenue, points or stored value, or multi\-party revenue.


**What we offer**


Fringe is remote\-first, with an office in Richmond, VA for those who want it. Beyond the scope of the role itself, here's what comes with it:


* Competitive salary.
* Employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for individuals and families.
* 3% company match on 401(k) retirement

* Manage the Cortiva business unit’s GPO/IDN agreement portfolio and pricing strategy – including access\- and tier\-based pricing across major GPOs (Vizient, Premier, HealthTrust, Ascension), margin analysis, and large RFP/RFQ responses.
* Serve as the Commercial Operations functional lead on enterprise data and systems initiatives (ERP/NetSuite migration, Enterprise Data Warehouse, and star\-schema data\-governance modeling) across discovery, requirements, data migration, and go\-live readiness.
* Manage customer master, pricing, and territory data governance in the ERP system, ensuring accuracy, standardization, and compliance with regulatory and business rules.
* Lead commercial funnel management, targeting, and territory analytics – including CRM/pipeline administration, KPI tracking, and territory design incorporating outside data sources (e.g., TAM and IDN strength).
* Lead and coach the consignment team on day\-to\-day inventory operations – inventory\-on\-hand analysis, back\-order monitoring, and near\-expiration reporting – working hands\-on with the team to make timely recommendations to the field.
* Support the rollout of the EvergenConnect Field Inventory app by gathering and compiling field\-user feedback, identifying enhancement opportunities, and helping drive adoption across the consignment team and field.
* Roll up knowledge of the full assigned portfolio to support field\-generated inquiries and personally handle day\-to\-day ad hoc requests including contracting, pricing quotes, approvals, reporting, and consignment or Temp Purchase Orders (POs).

**Requirements**


Education

Experience

* Demonstrated player\-coach experience – leading a team (e.g., a consignment or commercial operations team)

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager is an advanced project management professional who handles the largest and most complex automation projects, planning and overseeing multiple concurrent project implementations to ensure they are completed on time and within budget. This role develops and manages project plans, designates project resources and prepares budgets, and monitors project status. The Senior Project Manager identifies and troubleshoots issues and keeps stakeholders informed throughout the implementation of the project.

  


**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  




* Oversees all aspects of the project lifecycle: planning, scope definition, design, execution, and delivery. Organizes and oversees the staffing of the project.
* Ensures the engineering integrity of systems such that the contractual specifications are met with respect to system functionality, productivity, reliability, quality, and safety.
* Maintains and regularly updates project schedule, open items list, and risk register.


* Manages project budget and forecasting of costs. Proactively identifies potential over\-runs and develops mitigation plan to minimize negative impact to project.
* Coordinates with engineering, purchasing, and manufacturing for material requisitions and equipment deliveries to meet project milestones. Monitors progress against milestones, budget guidelines, and other performance indicators.
* Balances concurrent assignments as Project Manager, managing responsibilities such as developing bid packages, evaluating bids, processing POs, and monitoring vendors. Assists with the selection of vendors and manages all activities regarding external consultants and vendors.
* Keeps management informed of on\-going issues and potential concerns that may be escalated by the customer.


* Maintains comprehensive and complete documentation of situations that can lead to claims against TGW.


* Performs additional duties as required.

  


**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent technical systems experience.

  




**Experience:** Minimum of six (6\) years of technical systems experience, preferably in material handling industry.

  




**Travel:** Approximately 60% of domestic and international travel as required.

  




**Skills \& Abilities**

  




* Strong background in engineering automation industry
* System\-level working knowledge of Mechanical, PLC Controls, and Software Engineering
* Demonstrated experience leading and managing large project teams
* Strong proficiency with project management software (e.g. Microsoft Project)
* Excellent communication skills, with ability to communicate effectively across a variety of audiences.
* Robust knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)
* Formal Project Management certification (e.g., PRINCE2, PMI, or other recognized methodologies) preferred.

  




**Physical Requirements**

  




* Ability to remain stationary at a desk for prolonged periods of time.
* Ability to go to site frequently and move safely around industrial and/or warehouse environment.
* Ability to lift and carry supplies up to 25 pounds at a time.


* Ability to operate computers, tablets, phones, and other electronic devices.
* Ability to communicate with others verbally and in writing, on a frequent basis.


* Ability to tolerate exposure to job site temperature fluctuations due to seasonal weather in geographic region.

  




The physical demands described above are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  




**Other Requirements**

  




This position may require work at TGW customer sites. TGW’s customers may require background checks before accessing their sites. Refusal to participate in a customer\-required background check may result in a customer barring access and a subsequent reduction in work.

  




**Equal Opportunity Employer**

---------------------



The Senior Project Information Management Program Manager provides senior leadership for Kiewit’s Industrial District Project Information Management (PIM) Program and Information Management/Document Control organization. This role is responsible for building and leading a high\-performing information management function that supports project execution, strengthens governance, develops talent, and drives consistent information practices across the industrial market.

  




This position partners with engineering and operations leadership, functional leaders, and project teams to standardize execution, improve processes, align systems and workflows, and ensure project information is controlled from startup through final turnover and closeout.


**District Overview**
---------------------



Kiewit’s Industrial District delivers complex construction and engineering projects across North America, including advanced technology, power, industrial, and other large\-scale markets. Our teams operate in fast\-paced project environments that require disciplined execution, strong coordination, and reliable information management. This role is key to helping project teams establish the standards, systems, and controls needed to manage project information effectively throughout the full project lifecycle.


**Location**
------------



This position may be based in a district or area office, depending on business needs. Candidates must be willing to travel as required to support project assignments.

  




\#LI\-LH1

**Responsibilities**
--------------------



District Leadership \& Program Ownership  

* Serve as the district leader and primary champion for the Project Information Management Program.
* Lead development, deployment, and continuous improvement of district PIM standards, procedures, playbooks, tools, and assurance processes.
* Influence operations, functional leaders, and project teams to align information management requirements with project needs and delivery models.
* Establish district\-wide governance, metrics, reporting requirements, and assurance processes.
* Drive consistency across engineering, procurement, construction, startup, commissioning, turnover, and final records management.
* Lead staffing projections, recruiting support, resource planning, and project deployment strategy for Information Management/Document Control personnel.
* Develop talent through onboarding, mentoring, career development, succession planning, and leadership coaching.


Project Startup, Implementation \& Governance

* Lead project startup and Information Readiness Reviews to confirm systems of record, workflows, responsibilities, reporting needs, contract requirements, and project\-specific PIM expectations.
* Review project implementation plans and provide recommendations for improvement.
* Assist projects in developing information management strategies based on project size, complexity, client requirements, and delivery model.
* Support implementation of Engineering Information Management, Trade Partner Information Management (TPIM), Vendor Data Management, and Turnover Information Management programs.


Information Lifecycle, Turnover \& Closeout  

* Establish governance for engineering information, vendor data, trade partner information, submittals, RFIs, design changes, quality records, commissioning records, turnover packages, final records, and archives.

Trade Partner Information Management

Requisition ID: 2026\-4658 Job Summary:

We seek an experienced Project Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Strategic Planning Division (SPD)/Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI). CCPI advances VHA as a center for the development of data\-driven, value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden, and leads legislatively directed pilot initiatives. This role will serve as the Task Order (TO) Project Manager, the primary Contractor point of contact with SPD/CCPI and the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), supporting a portfolio of up to six concurrent pilots and associated CCPI program management activities, working closely with the contract\-aligned Program Director, workstream leads, and Government leadership to ensure task order requirements are executed consistently and in accordance with VA standards and enterprise objectives.

  


Primary Responsibilities:

The Project Manager is responsible for maintaining the Government\-approved Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Charter, integrated schedule, milestones, RAID Log, and Stakeholder Registry, and for developing and maintaining a Portfolio Management Dashboard that provides portfolio\-wide visibility into status, milestones, risks, dependencies, decision points, and funding across all active pilots and workstreams. This includes leading a weekly status meeting with the COR and producing a Weekly Task Report; preparing a semi\-monthly budget and schedule tracker and a Monthly Progress Report covering budget, schedule, staffing, and performance; and preparing scoping letters for emerging in\-scope requirements, as requested by the Government. The role also facilitates working sessions, stakeholder meetings, and decision\-making forums, and maintains centralized repositories, action trackers, and risk/issue logs necessary to support program continuity and portfolio oversight.

  

In this role, the Project Manager collaborates with the Program Director, Pilot Project Manager, Stakeholder Engagement \& Communications Specialist, and Technical Writer/Editor to ensure coordinated execution across the SPD/CCPI portfolio and supports development of executive\-ready briefing materials for SES leadership, governance bodies, and Congressional reporting. Responsibilities include tracking approved scope changes; maintaining organized project files using version control and records management practices; and providing Government customers with timely reporting on status, schedule, risks, issues, and performance metrics to support informed decision\-making.


Minimum Qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS)
* Minimum four (4\) years of experience successfully managing a large\-scale, complex program encompassing multiple projects
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, with a minimum of four (4\) years' experience supporting a large corporation or government agency, preferably a large health care organization
* Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
* Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States (no visa sponsorship).

Desired Qualifications:
* Master’s degree
* Eight (8\) or more years of experience managing large\-scale, complex programs or projects, preferably within a large health care organization

jobs.title: Program Launch Manager
jobs.description:
**About Convergent Research**
-----------------------------



Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO). We design, launch, and support mission\-driven, time\-bound organizations built to solve important scientific and engineering bottlenecks.



FROs are designed to tackle the kinds of problems that benefit from unusual levels of focus, coordination, and scale. Convergent provides the operational backbone that allows FRO teams to move quickly—from legal formation, funding, hiring, finance, and governance to partnerships, communications, and operational systems.



We’ve now taken 14 FROs from idea to operating entity, including four launches in 2026\. And we’re not slowing down.

  


**About the Role**
------------------



Turning an ambitious scientific idea into a functioning organization requires a lot more than good science.



There are entities to form, teams to hire, systems to stand up, funders and partners to coordinate, decisions to make, and approximately one million details that need to happen in the right order. At the same time, the founders doing this work are often building an organization for the first time.



That’s where you come in.



As our **Program Launch Manager**, you’ll sit at the center of the FRO lifecycle. You’ll help promising scientific projects become functioning organizations while also running large\-scale founder programs that develop the next generation of FROs.



You’ll be part project manager, part operator, and part trusted partner. One minute you might be building a launch plan across legal, finance, people, and IT. The next, you’re helping a scientist understand an unfamiliar operational decision, chasing down a dependency that could delay launch, or making sure a founder residency participant has what they need to make progress.



This isn’t a traditional project\-management or account\-management role. Our systems and playbooks are still evolving, and every FRO is different. You’ll need to bring structure without creating bureaucracy, keep things moving without losing sight of the people involved, and turn what we learn from every launch into a better system for the next one.



### **You Are (Skills):**

* **A project manager who can make ambiguity actionable.** Give you a complicated goal with multiple teams, unclear dependencies, and a moving timeline, and you can turn it into a practical plan. You know who owns what, what needs to happen next, where the risks are, and which decisions are holding everything else up.
* **Operationally rigorous.** You notice the details that matter. You keep accurate records, follow through reliably, and know that a small operational gap today can become a much larger problem three weeks from now.
* **People\-centered and emotionally intelligent.** Launching an organization can be exciting, confusing, stressful, and occasionally all three before lunch. You build trust quickly, meet people where they are, and know when to coach, facilitate, advise, push, or simply listen.
* **A confident, clear, proactive communicator.** You can run an effective meeting, write a concise status update, ask the uncomfortable\-but\-important question, and translate complicated processes into something another human can actually understand. You’re equally comfortable working with scientists, founders, executives, vendors, funders, and functional specialists.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity.** You’ve worked somewhere entrepreneurial—perhaps a startup, nonprofit, consultancy, research organization, or similar environment—where not every process came with an instruction manual. You bring structure while recognizing that the right answer may be different for every FRO.
* **A fan of functional systems.** After doing something manually for the fifth time, you start wondering whether there’s a better way. You like turning bespoke work into useful processes, templates, documentation, and operating rhythms—and you’re interested in using automation and AI thoughtfully when they can make those systems better.
* **A great juggler.** Multiple launches, founder programs, stakeholders, decisions, and deadlines don’t scare you. You can manage several workstreams at once, adjust when priorities change, and keep things moving without adding unnecessary process.

### **You Will (Duties):**

* **Lead FRO launches.** You’ll own the day\-to\-day coordination of one or more FRO launches, bringing together Convergent’s legal, finance, people, compliance, procurement, IT, fundraising, communications, and leadership teams. Measure and summarize impact against relevant KPIs, and capture lessons learned for future process work.

As the Finance x Operations project progresses and bandwidth allows, this role will expand to include:

* Serving as a point of contact liaising with suppliers on behalf of Operations, coordinating communications and following up on open items.
* Supporting cross\-functional projects with other internal departments beyond Finance and Operations, as priorities arise.
* Taking on additional operations projects and initiatives as assigned, based on demonstrated capacity and performance.

**What You'll Bring**

* Exceptional project management skills — the ability to organize multiple concurrent workstreams, track details, and reliably drive projects to completion.
* Confidence and polish working with, and managing up to, senior leadership; comfortable pushing timelines and holding stakeholders accountable.
* A proactive, ownership\-oriented mindset — someone who identifies what needs to happen next and moves it forward without waiting to be asked.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for documentation, process write\-ups, and stakeholder updates.
* Comfort working across ambiguity and shifting priorities as the role grows from a defined project into broader cross\-functional support.
* 1–3\+ years of relevant work experience in operations, project management, finance, or a related field; Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Familiarity with financial processes (AR/collections, expense management, vendor/contractor payments) and tools like Salesforce or NetSuite is a plus, but not required — we're prioritizing project management and leadership\-facing skills over specific tool expertise.

**Engagement Details**

* This is a temporary, W2 role, not initially benefits\-eligible, unless and until converted to permanent employment.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Technical)
jobs.description:
**Project Manager (Technical)**
-------------------------------


**Location:** Remote US


**Who We Are:**
---------------



Enterra Solutions is introducing the world's top brands and market leaders to true enterprise intelligence. Powered by our groundbreaking Enterra Autonomous Decision Science™ Platform, we're delivering enterprise\-wide optimization and decision\-making to help businesses best achieve their most complex goals. We're providing real human insights to facilitate smarter, faster market moves. And we're turning unknowns into opportunities for unprecedented growth and agility. All with next\-level speed, accuracy, autonomy, and continuous learning. We're shaping the future \- join a dynamic, collaborative team where your contributions drive real impact.


**Overview**



The Project Manager (PM) oversees the planning, execution, and successful completion of projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, client expectations, and quality standards. The PM serves as a central point of communication between stakeholders and project teams, manages resources effectively, mitigates risks, and drives continuous process improvement to maximize the success and profitability of projects.


**What You'll Do:**
-------------------


* Define project scope, deliverables, tasks, timelines, and charters; develop comprehensive project plans in MS Project and Excel aligned with client and organizational requirements.
* Monitor progress against plans, adjust timelines and resources as needed, ensure high\-quality delivery, and manage project closure activities including documentation, postmortems, and lessons learned.
* Allocate tasks, assign backup resources, provide guidance and direction to team members, and ensure efficient utilization of internal and external project resources.
* Identify root causes of issues, develop effective resolutions, and implement risk mitigation and contingency plans to prevent project delays or obstacles.
* Serve as the central point of contact for project teams, clients, and internal stakeholders; provide regular updates, schedule and facilitate meetings, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Manage project\-related Teams sites, PMO meetings, and documentation; maintain organized and accurate records of all project communications and materials.
* Perform other related duties as required, including coordination with external stakeholders, vendors, or partners.

**Your Skill\-set:**
--------------------


**Requirements:**


* Bachelor's of Master's degree in business, project management, or a related field.
* Experience delivering technology solutions within the Consumer\-Packaged Goods (CPG) industry required, ideally within trade promotion management (TPM).
* 3–5 years of experience managing technical client\-facing projects within the CPG industry, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholders, project scope, resources, schedules, and communications effectively.
* Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall methodologies, with hands\-on experience using Jira and Microsoft Project.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating with technical teams, clients, and vendors.


**Nice\-to\-haves:**


* Project management certification such as PMP or CAPM.
* Master's degree in business, project management, or related field.
* Experience managing projects in SaaS, technology, or client\-facing consulting environments.


**Additional Information**



Must reside in the US – preferably in the Northeast or Mid\-Atlantic Regions. Remote work permitted. Occasionally, travel may be needed based on client, project, or business need. Candidates must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship. This is a full\-time position with benefits.


**What We Offer:**
------------------



We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer:


* Competitive compensation
* Fully paid "employee only" health insurance (medical, dental, and vision) or employer contribution toward various health insurance plans
* 15 days PTO \+ 7 holidays \+ 3 floating holidays
* 401k offering


**Equal Employment Opportunity:**



Enterra Solutions provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands, financial institutions, and fintechs get compelling consumer products to market faster. We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API. Our private label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.



As a remote\-first company, we're focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.



We are looking for a motivated Project Manager to join our growing organization. This position is based in the United States and can work cross\-functionally on projects across all teams, with a likely focus on revenue operations for enterprise sales teams. You are forward\-thinking and create efficiencies while pushing through roadblocks. This role reports to the PMO manager.


**You Will:**


* Work closely with senior leadership and high performing revenue driven teams.
* Take initiative and not wait for work to be assigned and contextualized.
* Collaborate across departments to accomplish projects, processes and high priority tasks.
* Proactively identify needs of project deliverables from launch through close.
* Identify appropriate stakeholders on new projects and work with third\-party vendors, managing tracking of progress.
* Monitor the progress of projects and adapt to ensure successful outcomes.
* Support several levels of stakeholders including the CEO, other C\-level executives, and project leads on ad hoc requests.
* Create detailed technical documentation of errors, issues, and resolutions.
* Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster—it's your default, not an afterthought.


**You Have:**


* Experience in or strong familiarity with SaaS companies and startup environments, with the ability to operate at startup speed.
* Experience supporting revenue teams (sales, client success, or partnerships) preferred.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, including attention to detail and managing up and across the organization in order to execute projects.
* Ability to work independently and follow processes with minimal supervision.
* Willing and excited to learn about new parts of the business.
* Interest in understanding our business and array of B2B2C SaaS products.
* Proficiency in understanding and creating reports and manipulating data with AI tools, SQL and Excel.
* A belief that AI is reshaping work, you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do.


**Pay transparency:** $90,000 \+ for base salary, depending on experience. Full time employee compensation includes an Incentive Stock Option (ISO) grant, subject to Board approval.


**Expected interview process:** Recruiter Conversation \- Hiring Manager Interview \- Loop round:


**Expected onboarding process:** Onboarding at Array is active, not passive: new hires spend their first two weeks building fluency in our products, customers, and value proposition, and are expected to pass scored assessments before beginning role\-specific work. Success means meeting defined performance standards through a six\-month evaluation period — with continuous feedback and ongoing accountability as core parts of working at Array.


**Array Offers All Full Time Employees the following Benefits and Perks:**


* Full medical, dental, and vision, premiums covered at 100% for full\-time employees and 70% for dependents
* Unlimited PTO and sick leave \+ 14 company holidays to encourage a healthy work\-life blend
* 100% 401k match up to 4% with immediate vesting
* Generous and competitive parental leave for all parents
* $1,000 desk setup subsidy to set\-up your unique remote office
* $100/month to subsidize wifi/cell phone expenses
* Summer Fridays (half\-day Fridays) typically from late May to the end of August
* Commuter benefits for those who choose to go into our New York City or San Francisco office spaces


*Not sure if you meet the Qualifications? We know that folks tend to only apply if they check every box. If you think you have the appropriate qualifications, but don't meet every single one, we encourage you to still apply. We'd love to hear from you.*


*We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace; we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Array will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants—if you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please email talent@array.com to make your request.*


*Array uses CLEAR to conduct identity verification as part of the application process. We encourage you to review CLEAR's* *Privacy Notice* *and* *Terms of Use* *to understand how your personal data will be processed.*

jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

**You are organized, driven, and thrive in an ownership role.**  

  

The Senior Program Manager serves as the primary point of contact and gateway into the studio for a defined set of clients, including Syneos Communications agencies and Syneos Health Clinical departments. Acting as a holistic business partner, the Senior Program Manager ensures the studio delivers on client needs and expectations. This role is accountable for ensuring overall client satisfaction. The Senior Program Manager reports directly to the Director, Program Management.  

  

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for defining project parameters, contributing to creative ideation sessions, and participating in tactical recommendation brainstorming. Once project parameters are aligned between the client and the studio, the Senior Program Manager leads and oversees the project from start to finish, including budget development, timeline creation, and management of deliverable routing. The Senior Program Manager should possess deep knowledge of the creative process and have experience with print production.  

  

This role partners closely with the studio teams and serves as the primary lead for one our internal communication teams, ensuring that work is routed appropriately to necessary stakeholders. The Senior Program Manager ensures that the Creative team is fully integrated into the workflow and redirects relevant projects to them as needed.  

  

**Client and Business Management*** Serves as the studio’s lead representative, ensuring client expectations are consistently met.
* Builds, maintains, and nurtures strong relationships with key stakeholders across disciplines.
* Acts as an advocate for the studio by continually building organizational awareness of its value, including coordinating capability presentations, and proactively promoting and recommending studio services as appropriate.
* Handles challenges professionally and navigates disagreements diplomatically to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Represents the studio in new business opportunities.
* Acts as the primary escalation point for quality issues, workflow gaps, or performance concerns, and partners with studio leadership to address concerns related to studio performance, personnel, or potential client issues.
* Responsible for hiring, training, and managing a team of direct reports, including conducting annual performance reviews and supporting career development.

  

**Intake**  

* Serves as the gatekeeper for all incoming projects, ensuring requests are clearly defined and include all necessary information (e.g., confirmed budgets, links, assets, requirements).
* Directs projects to the appropriate team or discipline lead (Content Production, Technology, etc.) who will assign resources accordingly.
* Represents the studio holistically during key milestones, including triage and intake meetings, project status meetings, project planning, scoping discussions, and RFP processes.

  

**Execution**  

* Develops project estimates, timelines, and resource plans based on a deep understanding of program management and client partnership trajectories.
* Manages the day\-to\-day workflow of deliverables in alignment with the approved scope of work.
* Defines the “how” and “when” of project delivery and empowers teams to meet shared expectations and goals.
* Oversees and manages project budgets through regular tracking, reporting, and proactive problem\-solving.
* Maintains deep knowledge of the creative development process and print production workflows.

  

**Key Competencies**  

* 5\-8 years of experience in program management, delivery operations, or studio/agency experience
* Strategic and inspiring leader
* Strong ability to manage multiple clients, projects, and priorities while proactively anticipating issues
* Anticipates and resolves issues with a proactive, solution\-oriented approach; skilled at de\-escalating situations and making confident decisions
* Brings hands\-on experience in print production
* Skilled at fostering strong team morale and creating an environment of open and honest dialogue
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Client\-facing professional with broad understanding of studio services
* Strong presentation, sales, and marketing capabilities
* Keen creative eye for quality control
* Team management experience
* Ability to operate effectively within an integrated, networked service model


The anticipated hourly rate for this position is $55\.00 \- $65\.00 but may vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role.

At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**About A.C.T.I.O.N.**



A.C.T.I.O.N. is a proposed community\-wide overdose prevention initiative that will expand access to FDA\-approved opioid overdose reversal medications (OORMs), community training, and treatment referral pathways across the twelve counties of Alabama's 4th Congressional District (Lauderdale, Colbert, Franklin, Marion, Lamar, Fayette, Walker, Winston, Cullman, Marshall, DeKalb, and Blount). This position is contingent upon receipt of federal SAMHSA grant funding.



**Position Summary**



The Community Health Worker (CHW) for Cluster 4 is responsible for opioid overdose reversal medication (OORM) distribution, overdose\-recognition and response training, and referral follow\-up within Marshall, DeKalb and Blount Counties, working in close partnership with the cluster's designated community partner organization. This locally embedded, field\-based role requires strong ties to the assigned counties.



**Key Responsibilities**



* Distribute FDA\-approved OORMs (naloxone and nalmefene) to bystanders, community sectors, and rural first responders within Marshall, DeKalb and Blount Counties.
* Deliver overdose\-recognition, response, and OORM\-administration training to both traditional partners (healthcare providers, pharmacies, EMS, school systems) and non\-traditional community sectors (e.g., gas station attendants, motel staff, retail employees, postal workers).
* Train local Training\-of\-Trainers cohorts to extend the training curriculum further into the community.
* Support referral and linkage follow\-up for individuals identified through prevention or overdose response activities, in coordination with the Program Coordinator/Data Lead.
* Maintain local relationships with the cluster's designated community partner, healthcare providers, pharmacies, faith\-based organizations, and schools.
* Complete required data collection instruments accurately and submit them to the Program Coordinator/Data Lead on the required schedule.
* Participate in the Local Community Prevention Collaborative and community\-facing outreach and distribution events.

**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in public health, social work, or a related field
* Local, rural\-based residency or strong ties to Marshall, DeKalb and Blount Counties, with community trust and lived familiarity with the area.
* Community health worker certification or equivalent lived or professional experience preferred.
* Strong local community relationships and the trust of area residents.
* Ability to complete Aletheia House's overdose\-recognition and naloxone\-administration training during onboarding (provided).
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel within the assigned counties for distribution and training visits.
* Comfortable with basic data entry and reporting tools.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Care Coordinator - Clinical Pharmacy Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**A bit about this role:**


Devoted Medical is building clinical programs to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted's values of treating every member like family. Medication plays a crucial role in helping people manage chronic conditions, but in many cases effective medication management is limited by barriers to access, uncoordinated prescribing, or a failure to use the most effective evidence\-based medication therapies. For example, despite a mountain of evidence, less than 1 in 10 people with congestive heart failure (CHF) are prescribed evidence\-based medications proven to save lives and prevent hospitalizations.


Devoted's clinical pharmacy team aims to support improved therapeutics for Devoted members. It supports this work in three ways:

* *Conducting medication reviews (via direct member engagement and pharmacist consult support for other clinicians)*
* *Virtual pharmacist\-led or clinician\-led care via telemedicine to close therapy gaps*
* *Coordinating care for changes in therapy by counseling members and engaging prescribers and pharmacies*

**This work is done in service of a number of goals. The clinical pharmacy team drives Devoted's quality and Medicare Stars performance across multiple programs such as:**

* **SUPD (Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes)**
* **SPC (Statin Use in Persons with Heart Disease)**
* **MTM (Medication Therapy Management)**
* **TCC (Total Cost of Care)**
* **Polypharmacy**


During appointments with our pharmacists and clinicians, medication opportunities are identified.That's where Pharmacy Care Coordinators (PCCs) step in. PCCs ensure recommendations reach the outside provider, follow up with pharmacies on claims issues, pick\-up confirmations, or discontinuations, and keep the member informed of any changes along the way.


As a PCC, you will partner with our Clinical Pharmacy and Operations teams on outreach, coordination, and follow\-up to provide best in class care to our members, as part of a mission\-driven, team\-oriented, joyful culture.

 **Responsibilities and Impact will include:**

* Supports clinical outreach campaigns by making outbound calls and utilizing portal chat to members to schedule appointments with the pharmacist team to address clinical gaps or medication concerns
* Supports cost of care efforts by reaching out to providers and members to offer lower cost alternative medication options
* Manages an assigned caseload which may require provider, pharmacy, and/or member follow\-up to address medication recommendations, concerns, or questions
* Independently oversees assigned cases and outreaches with timely follow\-up, clear next steps, and thorough documentation
* Helps members navigate their Devoted Health benefits
* Participates in sprints, pilots, and special projects as they launch
* Collaborates with the broader pharmacy team to support shared goals and coverage needs
* Assists with training and shadowing when new team members join the team
* Participates in team and pharmacy department activities and responsibilities

**Required skills and experience:**

* At least 3 years of work experience in health care or retail pharmacy
* Active National PTCB Certification
* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to members, providers, and pharmacies
* Comfortable managing daily responsibilities and tasks independently
* Ability to shift between tasks, projects, and priorities frequently

**Desired skills and experience:**

* Highly organized and detail\-driven
* Comfortable learning new software and adapting as tools and workflows evolve
* Adaptable and flexible, with a willingness to take on new or shifting tasks positively
* A true team player who brings new ideas to the table, works through solutions with others, and lifts up their teammates
* Comfortable speaking with physicians, pharmacies, and patients, with a genuine passion for our members
* Thrives in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* A transparent communicator about your work, what's going well, and what's not, with a thoughtful eye for improving processes

***Salary range:*** $23\.00 \- $30\.00 hourly

==================================================


**About InSource Solutions**
----------------------------



InSource Solutions is a leading industrial software solutions provider and a trusted partner of AVEVA, a global leader in engineering and industrial software. --------------------



The Training and Commercial Operations Coordinator is responsible for the end\-to\-end coordination and administration of InSource's training programs while also supporting sales and operations teams with customer onboarding and commercial account setup.



This role serves as the primary point of contact for training registrations, inquiries, scheduling, payment coordination, and logistics, helping ensure a seamless experience for students while supporting trainers in delivering an organized and financially effective training operation.



The Training and Commercial Operations Coordinator also supports customer onboarding activities, including documentation collection, credit checks, insurance compliance, and account setup. Notify registered students of cancellations and proactively provide alternative options.

* **Payment and Coupon Administration:** Process credit card payments directly, prepare quotes for purchase\-order or invoice\-based registrations, and process resulting purchase orders. Validate training coupons against authorized coupon types, including unlimited training subscriptions and System Integrator seats.

* **Credit and Commercial Setup:** Initiate and monitor credit checks and collaborate with Finance to establish customer credit terms.

* **Risk and Issue Management:** Identify and escalate risks, missing documentation, compliance concerns, or delays that could impact customer onboarding or order\-processing timelines.
* **Process Improvement:** Support continuous improvement initiatives across training administration, customer onboarding, and commercial operations processes.

jobs.title: User Operations Associate, Data Quality
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


Yelp’s User Operations department is searching for a detail\-oriented, analytically minded person to join our team as a Data Quality Associate.


This individual will be expected to have (or quickly develop) an in\-depth knowledge of Yelp’s business listing policy and front\-end product flows across all platforms.The core of the role will involve conducting quality assessments, identifying trends and patterns in data quality issues, surfacing improvements across data sources, and supporting escalations.  

The Data Quality Associate works cross\-functionally with teams across the User Operations department and the broader business, including coordination with an overseas team, in order to manage day\-to\-day quality operations.  

This is a full\-time remote role based in the United States.**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Assess the data quality of incoming data sources in order to determine viability and reliability.
* Onboard new data sources by running reports to ensure a data match.
* Train internal stakeholders on business listing standards and best practices.
* Develop data quality reporting standards and report quantitative and qualitative results in a concise and informative manner.
* Drive cross\-functional projects and initiatives across various internal teams (ie: engineering, product management and business development).
* Work independently and with other team members while managing stakeholder relationships and engaging in regular data quality discussions.
* Surface data quality issues and drive solutions with tech team stakeholders.
* Execute internal quality assessment exercises to identify poor quality data and zero\-in on calibration needs.
* Identify and drive data improvement projects from start to finish.
* Ensure deadlines are met across all workstreams.
* Maintain and update process documentation, policy references, and training materials as needed.
* Handle urgent escalations and lead in the decision\-making process to resolve the issue.

**What it takes to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
* You have at least 1\-2 years of experience in a quality assurance, operations, moderation, or a similar detail\-driven role.
* You are able to build trackers, pivot tables, and basic formulas in order to organize and analyze data quality in Google Sheets and/or Excel.
* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, and analyze significant amounts of information, identify patterns, and derive solutions to complex problems.
* You ideally have experience working with complex databases, such as: SQL, Splunk Reports, and Tableau.
* You have the ability to learn internal, “homegrown” tools and Content Management System (CMS) platforms quickly.
* You are comfortable working across time zones and coordinating with a distributed team.
* You have a willingness to utilize AI tools (ie: Claude), to accelerate analysis, documentation, and operational workflows.
* You have strong written communication skills, allowing for clearly formulated issue flagging and write\-ups.
* You have exceptional cross\-functional skills with the ability to translate between technical and non\-technical teams, including the ability to grasp complex engineering issues and concisely communicate them to affected parties.

* 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2\+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday

* Monthly wellness subsidy

* 401(k) retirement savings plan

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**OptioRx**

OptioRx is a dynamic premier national compounding pharmacy providing best in class patient care. We serve 50 states and are committed to fostering a team environment rooted in trust, innovation, efficiency, accountability, integrity, and energy.

**Position Summary**

The Sales Representative is responsible for generating qualified leads, conducting outbound prospecting, and supporting early\-stage customer engagement for OptioRx sales initiatives. This role follows established playbooks, uses CRM tools accurately, communicates company offerings clearly, and helps build foundational customer relationships that support pipeline growth.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

* Conduct cold calls, emails, and other outbound prospecting activities in accordance with established sales processes and outreach standards.
* Identify and qualify prospective customers by asking basic discovery questions, documenting needs, and determining appropriate next steps.
* Communicate OptioRx products, services, and value propositions clearly and professionally to prospects and customers.
* Maintain accurate and timely CRM records, including outreach activity, contact information, prospect status, notes, and follow\-up tasks.
* Handle straightforward customer interactions, qualifying questions, objections, and routine informational requests using approved scripts, playbooks, and resources.
* Support departmental outreach goals by completing assigned calls, emails, follow\-ups, appointments, and lead\-generation activities.
* Escalate complex customer questions, non\-standard requests, or higher\-value opportunities to more experienced sales team members or leadership.
* Participate in sales training, team meetings, coaching sessions, and campaign activities to strengthen product knowledge, prospecting skills, and sales effectiveness.
* Collaborate with teammates by sharing prospect information, customer insights, and market feedback that may improve sales outreach or pipeline development.
* Demonstrate professionalism, resilience, persistence, and strong customer service while representing OptioRx in prospect and customer interactions.
* Schedule introductory meetings, follow\-up calls, or handoffs with more experienced sales team members when prospects demonstrate potential interest.
* Maintain consistent follow\-up with assigned leads using approved outreach cadences, scripts, and communication templates.
* Support lead nurturing by sending approved materials, documenting prospect responses, and tracking next steps in the CRM.
* Assist with basic research on prospective customers, target accounts, and contact information to support outreach preparation.
* Provide timely updates to sales leadership or senior sales team members regarding prospect activity, barriers, and potential opportunities.
* Support newly identified account opportunities by organizing initial notes, contact details, and customer needs for transition to the appropriate sales owner.

NON\-ESSENTIAL DUTIES

* Assist with sales campaigns, market research, CRM cleanup, customer lists, and outreach projects as requested.
* Support onboarding or cross\-training activities by sharing basic process knowledge once proficient in assigned responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

* 0–1 years sales experience; high school diploma required, bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Basic understanding of customer service, outbound communication, lead generation, objection handling, and time management.
* Ability to learn company products, services, value propositions, target customer profiles, sales terminology, CRM systems, and prospecting techniques.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with prospects, customers, and internal teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate CRM documentation with minimal errors.
* Ability to follow established priorities, workflows, scripts, and standard operating procedures while receiving frequent coaching and feedback.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods, use a computer and phone, and perform routine office\-based work.
* Ability to conduct basic prospect research and prepare for outreach using available tools and approved resources.
* Comfortable making high\-volume outbound calls and sending professional follow\-up communications.
* Ability to recognize when a prospect requires escalation to a more experienced sales team member.
* Willingness to learn sales processes, product knowledge, customer profiles, and CRM expectations through coaching and training.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Prospecting Discipline: Consistently completes targeted outreach activities, follows established sales processes, and maintains focus on generating qualified opportunities.
* Customer Service: Communicates professionally, responds to customer and prospect needs appropriately, and represents OptioRx with a service\-oriented approach.
* CRM Accuracy: Maintains complete, timely, and accurate records of outreach activity, prospect information, notes, and follow\-up tasks.
* Communication: Clearly conveys information through verbal and written interactions while adapting messaging to prospects, customers, and internal team members.
* Time Management: Organizes daily priorities, completes assigned outreach and follow\-up activities, and manages work efficiently within established expectations.
* Resilience and Persistence: Maintains professionalism and motivation through rejection, objections, and repeated outreach while continuing to pursue sales goals.
* Coachability: Receives feedback, applies direction, and continues developing foundational sales skills.
* Attention to Detail: Captures accurate prospect information, next steps, and activity notes to support effective handoffs and follow\-up.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

* Revenue
* Product mix
* Daily activity, including phone calls in prospecting, sales cycle 1, and sales cycle 2
* New accounts added

jobs.description:

The Team Lead, Pharmacy Medication Adherence Program is an important colleague of ArchWell Health Pharmacy Team. Reporting to the Clinical Pharmacy Manager, Medication Adherence, this role will be leading a team of Pharmacy Technicians providing support and collaborating with other healthcare team members in a virtual environment to optimize the pharmaceutical care access for our members. This individual will provide and coordinate training when onboarding new team colleagues, ensure smooth daily operations of the team, and support clinical programs per existing protocols and assist members with navigating the medication use aspects, including reviewing components of their plan benefits. * Attend staff meetings and provide input into current trends, process evaluation, and quality improvement
* Additional duties, as assigned


**Required Skills/Abilities:**  

* High degree of emotional intelligence and integrity, resilient and focused work ethic, with adaptability to handle frequent changes with a positive attitude
* Ability to lead and mentor colleagues effectively and respectfully
* Self\-starter with the ability to think creatively and work effectively
* Excellent customer service, including telephone etiquette skills, active listening skills, and the ability to follow\-through with patients or staff members
* Strong attention to detail and possessing good alpha/numeric data entry skills with minimal errors
* Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite products including Word, Outlook and Excel plus a variety of other word\-processing, spreadsheet, database, e\-mail and presentation software
* Ability to travel on occasion for company meetings


**Education and Experience:**  

* Bachelor's degree in related field required or equivalent experience
* Registered Pharmacy Technician with a state board of pharmacy
* Minimum of five (5\) years of experience as a Pharmacy Technician, with a minimum of one (1\) year of CMS Quality measures or Medication Adherence required

* Be compassionate
* Strive for excellence
* Earn trust
* Show respect
* Stay resilient

At ArchWell Health, we’re creating a community of caring designed to help our members stay healthy and engaged. Our value\-based care model is designed to prevent illnesses while keeping members healthy and happy in every aspect of their life. We’re passionate about caring for older adults and united by the belief that caring has the power to change everything for our members.

jobs.title: Clinical Program Manager, Interpersonal Violence Reduction Program
jobs.description:
The **Program Manager** leads a care team of Therapists and Care Extenders, to implement our programs, serve members, and deliver outcomes to our health plan partners. Their care teams will empower members to actively participate in improving their own health and wellness through personalized case management that targets each member's specific needs. An innovative Program Manager seeks creative solutions to support Therapists, Care Extenders, and program goals, leading the team toward the desired operational, clinical and financial outcomes. As the leader of a remote team, they model a hands\-on approach, empowering the team to meet members where they are and tapping into the wide range of local resources to deliver whole\-person care. * Build communication strategies to ensure the team is engaging and building relationships with the member cohort in order to support members in reaching their goals.

* Collect and synthesize data that highlights member outcomes to support team training, improve high\-quality engagement, deepen internal understanding across markets, strengthen relationships with our partners, and enable us to continually drive toward results.
* Lead regular internal case review sessions, with individuals and with the team, for quality and training purposes. Participate in external case management meetings with health plan partners as needed.
* Perform required duties to maintain all program\-related and administrative data/reports, statistical records, and other data collection activities.
* Partner with the billing team to review prepared claims to ensure they accurately reflect services provided and provide additional information as needed.


**Education \& Work Experience:**


* Master's degree in behavioral health, social work or health care management from an accredited university required.
* An independent clinical behavioral health license in the state of **Nevada** is required. Eligible licenses include:
	+ Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
	+ Clinical Professional Counselor (CPC)
	+ Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
	+ Licensed Psychologist
* Experience leading, building and implementing programs and delivering outcomes.
* Experience with Health Coaching or Medical Social Work preferred.
* Experience with suicide prevention and crisis in the adolescent and young adult population, asf well as sever mental illness population preferred
* Experience managing interdisciplinary care teams preferred


**Skills Required:**


* **Management and compliance:** Experience ensuring care is delivered according to applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures, supporting the organization's integrity efforts by acting in an ethical and appropriate manner and that the team is operating at a level of excellence
