new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.

new_jobs.description:
**Before you apply, please read this carefully.**  

This is a quota\-driven, high\-volume outbound calling role. You will make 120\+ calls per day to patients eligible for Chronic Care Management programs, working toward weekly and monthly enrollment targets. The work is structured, fast\-paced, and numbers\-driven — closer to a sales or call center environment than a traditional healthcare role. If you thrive on clear goals, enjoy persuasive conversations, and are energized by hitting targets, this role is a strong fit. **What You Will Actually Do Day\-to\-Day:****This role is built around high\-volume outbound patient outreach and enrollment. Here is a realistic picture of a typical day:*** 120\+ outbound calls per day: You will work through a structured patient list, reaching out to individuals eligible for Chronic Care Management (CCM) to explain the program and enroll them.
* Persuasive, patient\-centered conversations: Your job is to clearly communicate the value of CCM, address hesitations, and guide patients to a yes — using an approach that is warm and informative, not pushy.
* Inbound call handling: You will also field inbound calls from patients with questions or concerns, handling them professionally and efficiently.
* Quota management: Weekly and monthly enrollment targets are set and tracked. Your performance is measured against these goals consistently.
* Intake coordination: For newly enrolled patients, you will conduct or support intake assessments and hand off to the Care Coordination team.
* Annual satisfaction outreach: You will conduct patient satisfaction calls for all practices on an annual cycle.

 **Who Thrives in This Role:****This role is a strong fit for candidates who have worked in environments like:*** Outbound call centers — healthcare, insurance, or benefits enrollment.
* Inside sales or phone\-based sales roles.
* Patient access, scheduling, or pre\-authorization roles with high call volume.
* Health plan outreach or member engagement programs.

 **You will do well here if you:*** Are energized by talking to people all day and naturally build rapport quickly over the phone.
* Stay motivated by targets and take ownership of your numbers.
* Can handle rejection gracefully and stay consistent call after call.
* Communicate clearly and adapt your approach to different patients.
* Are bilingual (English/Spanish) — bilingual candidates are strongly preferred.

 **Performance Expectations:*** Performance is measured by enrollment volume against weekly and monthly production quotas. Targets will be shared during onboarding.
* Consistently meeting or exceeding these targets is a core requirement of the role — not an aspiration.
* Call volume: 120\+ outbound calls per day is the baseline expectation.
* Enrollment targets: Weekly and monthly quotas are tracked and reviewed with your manager.
* Sustained underperformance may result in a performance improvement plan or, if unresolved, separation from the role.

 **Required Qualifications:*** Minimum 1 year of call center experience — healthcare setting strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding goals in a call center or phone\-based sales environment.
* Strong, clear, and engaging phone presence — you will be on the phone all day.
* Self\-directed and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Must reside and work in the continental US.
* CMA certification preferred but not required.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred.
* Experience with EHR or CRM platforms a plus.

 **Home Workspace Requirements — Please Confirm Before Applying:****This is a HIPAA\-regulated, phone\-based role. Your home workspace must meet these standards from day one:*** **Private, quiet workspace:** Free from pets, children, and background noise during all work hours.
* Wired internet connection: High\-speed, wired (not Wi\-Fi) internet capable of supporting VoIP calls is required. Please verify your setup before applying — this requirement cannot be waived.
* HIPAA\-compliant environment: No visible PHI, no shared working space during patient calls.
* Wellbox provides: laptop, headset, and all necessary software. You provide: the workspace and wired internet connection.

  

Please do not apply if your current home setup does not meet the wired internet requirement. **Schedule:*** Full\-time: 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday
* Hours: Generally 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; may vary slightly based on client needs
* This is a structured\-hours role. Availability during core hours is required.

 **Compensation:*** *$18 hourly.*
* *Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life.*
* *PTO, paid holidays, and 401k match.*

 **Still here? Great.**
If 120 calls a day sounds energizing rather than exhausting, and you are driven by knowing exactly how you are performing against a goal, we would love to talk. Every call you make is a chance to connect a patient with care they may not have known was available to them.  

This position is contingent upon completion of a satisfactory background check.

A hands\-on, player\-coach role leading Commercial Operations for the Cortiva business unit. * Act as a hands\-on player\-coach – leading and developing the Commercial Operations team while personally owning day\-to\-day deliverables, jumping into the work alongside the team, and setting the standard through direct execution.

* Own and actively maintain the business intelligence and reporting environment, including the design and governance of Microsoft Power BI reports, DAX/Power Query data models, and certified metric definitions that the team relies on daily.

* Help lead the launch of a dedicated Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) program for the Cortiva business unit – driving the migration of contract data (pricing, consignment, distribution, B2C, and territory) from interim SharePoint lists into a purpose\-built CLM system, and assisting with the project management and development effort from requirements and data mapping through configuration, testing, and go\-live.
* Serve as the business\-unit process owner for contract lifecycle management – defining workflows, milestone tracking, approval routing, and data\-governance standards that carry forward into the new CLM platform.
* Manage the Cortiva business unit’s GPO/IDN agreement portfolio and pricing strategy – including access\- and tier\-based pricing across major GPOs (Vizient, Premier, HealthTrust, Ascension), margin analysis, and large RFP/RFQ responses.
* Serve as the Commercial Operations functional lead on enterprise data and systems initiatives (ERP/NetSuite migration, Enterprise Data Warehouse, and star\-schema data\-governance modeling) across discovery, requirements, data migration, and go\-live readiness.
* Manage customer master, pricing, and territory data governance in the ERP system, ensuring accuracy, standardization, and compliance with regulatory and business rules.
* Lead commercial funnel management, targeting, and territory analytics – including CRM/pipeline administration, KPI tracking, and territory design incorporating outside data sources (e.g., TAM and IDN strength).
* Lead and coach the consignment team on day\-to\-day inventory operations – inventory\-on\-hand analysis, back\-order monitoring, and near\-expiration reporting – working hands\-on with the team to make timely recommendations to the field.
* Support the rollout of the EvergenConnect Field Inventory app by gathering and compiling field\-user feedback, identifying enhancement opportunities, and helping drive adoption across the consignment team and field.
* Roll up knowledge of the full assigned portfolio to support field\-generated inquiries and personally handle day\-to\-day ad hoc requests including contracting, pricing quotes, approvals, reporting, and consignment or Temp Purchase Orders (POs).

Education

Experience

The Senior Project Manager is an advanced project management professional who handles the largest and most complex automation projects, planning and overseeing multiple concurrent project implementations to ensure they are completed on time and within budget. This role develops and manages project plans, designates project resources and prepares budgets, and monitors project status. The Senior Project Manager identifies and troubleshoots issues and keeps stakeholders informed throughout the implementation of the project.

  


**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  




* Oversees all aspects of the project lifecycle: planning, scope definition, design, execution, and delivery. Organizes and oversees the staffing of the project.

* Maintains and regularly updates project schedule, open items list, and risk register.


* Manages project budget and forecasting of costs. Proactively identifies potential over\-runs and develops mitigation plan to minimize negative impact to project.
* Coordinates with engineering, purchasing, and manufacturing for material requisitions and equipment deliveries to meet project milestones. Monitors progress against milestones, budget guidelines, and other performance indicators.
* Balances concurrent assignments as Project Manager, managing responsibilities such as developing bid packages, evaluating bids, processing POs, and monitoring vendors. Assists with the selection of vendors and manages all activities regarding external consultants and vendors.
* Keeps management informed of on\-going issues and potential concerns that may be escalated by the customer.


* Maintains comprehensive and complete documentation of situations that can lead to claims against TGW.


* Performs additional duties as required.

  


**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent technical systems experience.

  




**Experience:** Minimum of six (6\) years of technical systems experience, preferably in material handling industry.

  




**Travel:** Approximately 60% of domestic and international travel as required.

  




**Skills \& Abilities**

  




* Strong background in engineering automation industry
* System\-level working knowledge of Mechanical, PLC Controls, and Software Engineering
* Demonstrated experience leading and managing large project teams
* Strong proficiency with project management software (e.g. Microsoft Project)
* Excellent communication skills, with ability to communicate effectively across a variety of audiences.
* Robust knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)
* Formal Project Management certification (e.g., PRINCE2, PMI, or other recognized methodologies) preferred.

  




**Physical Requirements**

  




* Ability to remain stationary at a desk for prolonged periods of time.
* Ability to go to site frequently and move safely around industrial and/or warehouse environment.
* Ability to lift and carry supplies up to 25 pounds at a time.


* Ability to operate computers, tablets, phones, and other electronic devices.
* Ability to communicate with others verbally and in writing, on a frequent basis.


* Ability to tolerate exposure to job site temperature fluctuations due to seasonal weather in geographic region.

  




The physical demands described above are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

new_jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 2026\-4658 Job Summary:

We seek an experienced Project Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Strategic Planning Division (SPD)/Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI). CCPI advances VHA as a center for the development of data\-driven, value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden, and leads legislatively directed pilot initiatives. This role will serve as the Task Order (TO) Project Manager, the primary Contractor point of contact with SPD/CCPI and the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), supporting a portfolio of up to six concurrent pilots and associated CCPI program management activities, working closely with the contract\-aligned Program Director, workstream leads, and Government leadership to ensure task order requirements are executed consistently and in accordance with VA standards and enterprise objectives.

  


Primary Responsibilities:

The Project Manager is responsible for maintaining the Government\-approved Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Charter, integrated schedule, milestones, RAID Log, and Stakeholder Registry, and for developing and maintaining a Portfolio Management Dashboard that provides portfolio\-wide visibility into status, milestones, risks, dependencies, decision points, and funding across all active pilots and workstreams. This includes leading a weekly status meeting with the COR and producing a Weekly Task Report; preparing a semi\-monthly budget and schedule tracker and a Monthly Progress Report covering budget, schedule, staffing, and performance; and preparing scoping letters for emerging in\-scope requirements, as requested by the Government. The role also facilitates working sessions, stakeholder meetings, and decision\-making forums, and maintains centralized repositories, action trackers, and risk/issue logs necessary to support program continuity and portfolio oversight.

  

In this role, the Project Manager collaborates with the Program Director, Pilot Project Manager, Stakeholder Engagement \& Communications Specialist, and Technical Writer/Editor to ensure coordinated execution across the SPD/CCPI portfolio and supports development of executive\-ready briefing materials for SES leadership, governance bodies, and Congressional reporting. Responsibilities include tracking approved scope changes; maintaining organized project files using version control and records management practices; and providing Government customers with timely reporting on status, schedule, risks, issues, and performance metrics to support informed decision\-making.


Minimum Qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS)
* Minimum four (4\) years of experience successfully managing a large\-scale, complex program encompassing multiple projects
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, with a minimum of four (4\) years' experience supporting a large corporation or government agency, preferably a large health care organization
* Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
* Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States (no visa sponsorship).

Desired Qualifications:
* Master’s degree
* Eight (8\) or more years of experience managing large\-scale, complex programs or projects, preferably within a large health care organization
* Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or Veterans Health Administration (VHA), particularly program/portfolio management, pilot or innovation programs, or value\-based health care initiatives
* Familiarity with federal health care environments and legislatively directed pilot programs, waiver processes, or enterprise transformation initiatives
* Experience developing executive\-level dashboards, status reporting, and portfolio\-management tools for senior leadership, governance boards, or Congressional audiences
* Additional relevant certification(s) (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, Change Management)

new_jobs.description:
**OptioRx**

OptioRx is a dynamic premier national compounding pharmacy providing best in class patient care. We serve 50 states and are committed to fostering a team environment rooted in trust, innovation, efficiency, accountability, integrity, and energy.

**Position Summary**

The Sales Representative is responsible for generating qualified leads, conducting outbound prospecting, and supporting early\-stage customer engagement for OptioRx sales initiatives. This role follows established playbooks, uses CRM tools accurately, communicates company offerings clearly, and helps build foundational customer relationships that support pipeline growth.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

* Conduct cold calls, emails, and other outbound prospecting activities in accordance with established sales processes and outreach standards.
* Identify and qualify prospective customers by asking basic discovery questions, documenting needs, and determining appropriate next steps.
* Communicate OptioRx products, services, and value propositions clearly and professionally to prospects and customers.
* Maintain accurate and timely CRM records, including outreach activity, contact information, prospect status, notes, and follow\-up tasks.
* Handle straightforward customer interactions, qualifying questions, objections, and routine informational requests using approved scripts, playbooks, and resources.
* Support departmental outreach goals by completing assigned calls, emails, follow\-ups, appointments, and lead\-generation activities.
* Escalate complex customer questions, non\-standard requests, or higher\-value opportunities to more experienced sales team members or leadership.
* Participate in sales training, team meetings, coaching sessions, and campaign activities to strengthen product knowledge, prospecting skills, and sales effectiveness.
* Collaborate with teammates by sharing prospect information, customer insights, and market feedback that may improve sales outreach or pipeline development.
* Demonstrate professionalism, resilience, persistence, and strong customer service while representing OptioRx in prospect and customer interactions.
* Schedule introductory meetings, follow\-up calls, or handoffs with more experienced sales team members when prospects demonstrate potential interest.
* Maintain consistent follow\-up with assigned leads using approved outreach cadences, scripts, and communication templates.
* Support lead nurturing by sending approved materials, documenting prospect responses, and tracking next steps in the CRM.
* Assist with basic research on prospective customers, target accounts, and contact information to support outreach preparation.
* Provide timely updates to sales leadership or senior sales team members regarding prospect activity, barriers, and potential opportunities.
* Support newly identified account opportunities by organizing initial notes, contact details, and customer needs for transition to the appropriate sales owner.

NON\-ESSENTIAL DUTIES

* Assist with sales campaigns, market research, CRM cleanup, customer lists, and outreach projects as requested.
* Support onboarding or cross\-training activities by sharing basic process knowledge once proficient in assigned responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

* 0–1 years sales experience; high school diploma required, bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Basic understanding of customer service, outbound communication, lead generation, objection handling, and time management.
* Ability to learn company products, services, value propositions, target customer profiles, sales terminology, CRM systems, and prospecting techniques.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with prospects, customers, and internal teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate CRM documentation with minimal errors.
* Ability to follow established priorities, workflows, scripts, and standard operating procedures while receiving frequent coaching and feedback.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods, use a computer and phone, and perform routine office\-based work.
* Ability to conduct basic prospect research and prepare for outreach using available tools and approved resources.
* Comfortable making high\-volume outbound calls and sending professional follow\-up communications.
* Ability to recognize when a prospect requires escalation to a more experienced sales team member.
* Willingness to learn sales processes, product knowledge, customer profiles, and CRM expectations through coaching and training.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Prospecting Discipline: Consistently completes targeted outreach activities, follows established sales processes, and maintains focus on generating qualified opportunities.
* Customer Service: Communicates professionally, responds to customer and prospect needs appropriately, and represents OptioRx with a service\-oriented approach.
* CRM Accuracy: Maintains complete, timely, and accurate records of outreach activity, prospect information, notes, and follow\-up tasks.
* Communication: Clearly conveys information through verbal and written interactions while adapting messaging to prospects, customers, and internal team members.
* Time Management: Organizes daily priorities, completes assigned outreach and follow\-up activities, and manages work efficiently within established expectations.
* Resilience and Persistence: Maintains professionalism and motivation through rejection, objections, and repeated outreach while continuing to pursue sales goals.
* Coachability: Receives feedback, applies direction, and continues developing foundational sales skills.
* Attention to Detail: Captures accurate prospect information, next steps, and activity notes to support effective handoffs and follow\-up.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

* Revenue
* Product mix
* Daily activity, including phone calls in prospecting, sales cycle 1, and sales cycle 2
* New accounts added

**Job Description**

*The ideal candidate for this role must be able to work during Eastern Time business hours (Monday \- Friday 8:30 am \- 5:30 pm ET)*

***A bit about this role:***
============================

  

Our Member Experience and Engagement (MXE) team designs the service experience that makes members trust and love Devoted — letters, SMS, calls, MyDevoted, chat, push. Our campaigns reach hundreds of thousands of older adults at moments that matter: a missed screening, a new diagnosis, a prescription that never got picked up.


As the Member Engagement Operations Associate, you'll be the reason those campaigns go out right. Working closely with our Member Engagement Operations Manager, you'll prep tickets, build audiences, run QA, keep documentation clean, monitor responses, and pull the numbers that tell us whether it worked. A meaningful share of this work supports Devoted Medical, our clinical arm: D2Me visits, clinical program activation, closing care gaps. When a campaign lands well, a member gets care they were going to miss.

  

You're the person who catches the missing comma, the wrong date, and the audience list that looks a little off. You pick up new tools fast and stay organized when a lot is in flight.

 **Two things about how we work:**

* **We test instead of assuming**. You'll build test and control arms and keep variants straight. A holdout handled carelessly turns a real answer into no answer at all.
* **Your manager sets the QA standard; you run it.** We expect you to tell us when a check is wrong, missing something, or could be automated. Spot a step that should be a template, a check that could be automated, or a doc three people maintain separately? We want to hear it. **Curiosity about AI and automation is important here.**

***Responsibilities and Impact will include:***
===============================================

### **Building and launching campaigns**

* Build, test, launch, and measure campaigns across SMS, email, print, outbound calls, MyDevoted, and chat with data analysts, member service guides, clinical partners, and product/tech
* Build audiences and configurations to spec, including test and control arms, with clean variant tracking
* Deliver against precise SOPs, timelines, and checklists, and keep every campaign compliant

### **Quality and contact hygiene**

* Run pre\- and post\-launch QA: audience verification, business rules, volume confirmation, SME review
* Apply suppression rules and check contact history, so a member who already heard from us this week doesn't get three more messages
* Flag checks that are wrong, missing, or automatable — improve the standard, don't just execute it
* Monitor responses after launch and escalate anything that looks wrong, fast

### **Keeping the system honest**

* Keep ticket documentation, status, and ownership current in Monday.com
* Support the refresh cycle for automated campaigns so content and logic don't go stale
* Maintain and tag our campaign inventory: what exists, what's reusable, what's a one\-off
* Get documentation to the member service and outreach teams running new campaigns

### **Measuring and reporting**

* Track and report campaign performance, including test versus control results
* Pull and check the numbers behind readouts
* Build and maintain the templates, checklists, and SOPs that make the process faster

***Required skills and experience:***
=====================================

* 1\-3 years in communications, digital strategy, engagement projects, or consulting — or a recent college/grad grad with internship experience or demonstrated ability
* Meticulous attention to detail and real care about getting things right
* Some experience using data and analytics tools to make decisions
* Quick to learn new tools and systems
* Able to simplify and clearly explain complex information
* Independent, collaborative, and communicative in a dynamic startup environment
* Able to work East Coast hours (\~8:30am–5:30pm ET)

***Desired Skills and experience:***
====================================

* Professional fluency in Spanish, written and spoken, including judgment on cultural relevancy and plain\-language translation quality. Preferred, not required — a meaningful share of our members read and speak Spanish
* Healthcare technology or public health experience
* Exposure to A/B testing, holdouts, or campaign measurement
* Familiarity with Monday.com, Asana, Jira, or similar
* Interest in using AI and automation to reduce manual work

**Integrity \&** **Trust** — the threshold expectation for every role at HealthEdge, above and ahead of the competency framework.

new_jobs.title: Learning & Development Consultant
new_jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Learning \& Development Consultant  
**Contract Type:** 1099 Independent Contractor  
**Hours:** Part\-time, varying according to engagement demand  
**Location:** Remote  
**Rate:** $70\.00 per hour  
**Start Date:** Immediate upon selection  
**Engagement:** Through March 31, 2027

**Role Overview**

CTM Unlimited is seeking a Learning \& Development Consultant to support two active enterprise AI enablement programmes.

This is a hands\-on consulting role supporting a multi\-workstream engagement spanning learning, enablement, change management and communications across a large, complex organisation. The programmes are expanding to cover new AI use cases and tools, including Adobe Firefly across a broad Creative Cloud user base.

The successful candidate will lead the design, development and delivery of training and enablement assets across both programmes.

This is not a traditional curriculum design role. We are looking for someone who can move quickly, work across multiple tools and audiences, and create practical enablement content that helps people confidently adopt new technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

Learning \& Development and Content

* Design and produce role\-based training guides, walkthroughs and how\-to resources tailored to different personas and use cases.
* Develop and maintain the enablement asset library across both enterprise AI programmes.
* Create use\-case\-specific learning materials and Adobe Firefly rollout content for a broad Creative Cloud user base.
* Refresh and update existing training content as new AI capabilities and tools are introduced.
* Ensure learning assets are clear, current, practical and easy for users to apply independently.

**AI Tool Rollout and Enablement**

* Design and execute enablement for the Adobe Firefly rollout across a broad Creative Cloud user base.
* Develop distinct messaging and learning paths for GenAI channel users and the wider creative population.
* Establish and manage post\-launch support mechanisms such as office hours, Q\&A forums and other adoption support.
* Sequence enablement activities across concurrent AI rollouts while taking change saturation into consideration.
* Work closely with the wider programme team to ensure training and enablement align with technical rollout schedules.

Leadership and Stakeholder Enablement

* Facilitate leadership alignment sessions focused on programme direction and priorities.
* Prepare and facilitate sessions with senior stakeholders, including navigating ambiguity and evolving programme priorities.
* Support champion networks with targeted enablement content and readiness materials.
* Work across different stakeholder groups and tailor learning approaches to their needs.

Adoption Tracking and Reporting

* Track adoption and usage across programme tools and the Adobe Firefly rollout.
* Report adoption progress to programme leadership.
* Translate adoption and usage data into clear insights and recommendations.
* Monitor adoption health and recommend adjustments to the enablement approach where required.

Programme Coordination

* Maintain the Coda workspace for enablement\-related trackers, pages and views.
* Compile and distribute weekly status reports for the L\&D and enablement workstreams.
* Maintain action items and decision logs.
* Support coordination across both programme workstreams.

What You Will Own

* Enablement asset design and format
* Training delivery sequencing and scheduling
* Adoption tracking approach and reporting cadence
* Office hours and post\-launch support model

What You Will Recommend

* Prioritisation when rollout timelines become compressed
* Escalation of adoption risks to the Engagement Partner
* Cross\-programme L\&D coordination across both workstreams

What You Will Collaborate On

* Messaging tone and content with the Change \& Communications Lead
* Persona definition and use\-case mapping with the wider programme team
* Client\-facing asset standards with the Engagement Partner

What This Role Is Not

* This is not a generalist Change Management role. The focus is on learning, enablement and training rather than the broader change strategy.
* This is not a content\-only role. You will be responsible for understanding whether the content you create is actually driving adoption.
* This is not a passive order\-taking role. You will be expected to use your professional judgement, challenge unrealistic timelines and identify when content is or is not ready for an audience.
* This is not a Project Manager role. Some coordination is required, but the primary responsibility is making enablement happen.
* This is not a full\-time embedded position. This is a part\-time independent contractor engagement requiring the ability to manage your own schedule.

Required Qualifications

* **5\+ years of experience** in Learning \& Development, Instructional Design or Enablement Consulting.
* Demonstrated experience creating learning and enablement content that successfully reaches users in complex organisations.
* Proven experience delivering **technology enablement programmes**, ideally involving enterprise software rollouts, digital transformation or AI/GenAI adoption.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholder personas and creating tailored learning experiences for different audiences.
* Comfortable facilitating sessions with senior leaders and supporting direction\-setting conversations.
* Strong written and visual communication skills, with the ability to produce polished, professional learning assets.
* Experience measuring adoption and translating usage data into meaningful insights and recommendations.
* Experience working within a consulting or advisory environment.
* Ability to work independently with limited infrastructure and oversight.
* Comfortable using AI tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot or Gemini** as part of your regular workflow.
* Previous 1099 independent contractor experience is preferred.
